sec01-card-sec01-F01.front: What credential is required before operating a vehicle on Massachusetts streets or public-access ways?
sec01-card-sec01-F01.expected_back: A valid driver license is required to drive a motor vehicle on Massachusetts roads or other ways open to public access.

sec01-card-sec01-F02.front: Which Massachusetts license class covers passenger vehicles, vans, and small trucks?
sec01-card-sec01-F02.expected_back: Massachusetts uses the Class D license for passenger vehicles, vans and small trucks.

sec01-card-sec01-F03.front: Who may reserve an RMV visit to begin the Class D licensing process?
sec01-card-sec01-F03.expected_back: A Massachusetts resident who is at least sixteen and whose license or operating privilege has not been revoked may reserve an RMV visit to start the Class D licensing process.

sec01-card-sec01-F04.front: Other than a Liquor ID card, who is eligible to receive a Massachusetts license or ID card?
sec01-card-sec01-F04.expected_back: A Massachusetts driver license or identification card, apart from a Liquor ID card, may be issued only to a Massachusetts resident.

sec01-card-sec01-F05.front: Does owning property or staying temporarily in Massachusetts qualify a non-resident for a driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-F05.expected_back: Owning Massachusetts property or staying temporarily in the state does not qualify someone for a license when their legal residence remains elsewhere.

sec01-card-sec01-F06.front: Can someone under sixteen drive in Massachusetts using a valid permit or license from another state?
sec01-card-sec01-F06.expected_back: Massachusetts prohibits anyone younger than sixteen from driving, even when another jurisdiction has issued that person a license or learner permit.

sec01-card-sec01-F07.front: What minimum age must an applicant reach before applying for a Class D learner permit?
sec01-card-sec01-F07.expected_back: An applicant must have reached sixteen before applying for a Class D learner permit.

sec01-card-sec01-F08.front: What three conditions must a teen meet for the early Class D license path at sixteen and a half?
sec01-card-sec01-F08.expected_back: For the early Class D licensing path described here, the applicant must be at least sixteen and a half, have held a permit in good standing for six consecutive months and have completed RMV-approved driver education.

sec01-card-sec01-F09.front: Where does Massachusetts require individuals convicted of sex offenses to register?
sec01-card-sec01-F09.expected_back: Massachusetts requires people convicted of sex offenses to register with the police department in their locality.

sec01-card-sec01-F10.front: Under what age is written permission required when applying for a permit, license, or state ID?
sec01-card-sec01-F10.expected_back: Applicants younger than eighteen need written consent for a permit, license or identification card.

sec01-card-sec01-F11.front: Which four adult roles are authorized to give written consent for an applicant under eighteen?
sec01-card-sec01-F11.expected_back: A parent, legal guardian, social worker or boarding-school headmaster may provide the written consent required for a minor applicant.

sec01-card-sec01-F12.front: Where does the consenting adult sign on a minor's permit or identification application?
sec01-card-sec01-F12.expected_back: For a learner permit or identification card, the consenting person signs the back of the permit, license or identification application.

sec01-card-sec01-F13.front: When someone other than a parent signs for a minor, when must proof of guardian status be shown?
sec01-card-sec01-F13.expected_back: When a minor’s application is signed by someone other than a parent, documentation of that person’s guardian status must be presented at the permit or identification application and at the road test for a license.

sec01-card-sec01-F14.front: What can happen to your license if an application signature is falsified?
sec01-card-sec01-F14.expected_back: Falsifying an application signature can cause a license to be suspended or revoked.

sec01-card-sec01-F15.front: Which five RMV credentials require capturing a photograph of every applicant?
sec01-card-sec01-F15.expected_back: The RMV must capture a photograph of every applicant for a learner permit, driver license, identification card, Liquor ID card or disability placard.

sec01-card-sec01-F16.front: How must an applicant face and appear in the required RMV photograph?
sec01-card-sec01-F16.expected_back: The required RMV photograph faces straight toward the camera and shows all facial features clearly.

sec01-card-sec01-F17.front: Are solid or transparent coverings over the face allowed in an RMV photograph?
sec01-card-sec01-F17.expected_back: A solid or transparent covering over the face is unacceptable for the RMV photograph.

sec01-card-sec01-F18.front: May you wear prescription or reading glasses when taking your RMV photograph?
sec01-card-sec01-F18.expected_back: Glasses cannot be worn for the RMV photograph, including prescription or reading glasses normally used by the applicant.

sec01-card-sec01-F19.front: Under what reasons and visibility condition may a head covering be worn in an RMV photo?
sec01-card-sec01-F19.expected_back: A head covering may be allowed for medical or religious reasons only when it leaves every facial feature visible.

sec01-card-sec01-F20.front: When are facial hair and hairpieces rejected in an RMV photograph?
sec01-card-sec01-F20.expected_back: Facial hair and hairpieces may be accepted in the RMV image unless they disguise the person’s actual appearance or conceal facial features.

sec01-card-sec01-F21.front: How does RMV photo policy treat permanent facial tattoos compared with temporary ones?
sec01-card-sec01-F21.expected_back: Permanent tattoos on the face are permitted in the RMV photograph, whereas temporary facial tattoos are not.

sec01-card-sec01-F22.front: Are Bluetooth headsets allowed to stay on during your RMV photograph?
sec01-card-sec01-F22.expected_back: Bluetooth headsets are not permitted in the RMV photograph.

sec01-card-sec01-F23.front: Who conducts a vision screen during a learner-permit or driver-license application?
sec01-card-sec01-F23.expected_back: An RMV clerk screens vision during a learner-permit or driver-license application.

sec01-card-sec01-F24.front: What three visual abilities does the RMV vision screen evaluate?
sec01-card-sec01-F24.expected_back: The RMV vision screen checks visual acuity, color vision and peripheral vision.

sec01-card-sec01-F25.front: What must applicants do for the vision screen if they normally wear contacts or glasses for distance?
sec01-card-sec01-F25.expected_back: Applicants who normally use contacts or other corrective lenses for distance vision must wear them for the vision screen.

sec01-card-sec01-F26.front: What minimum acuity and horizontal peripheral vision are required for an unrestricted full Class D license?
sec01-card-sec01-F26.expected_back: A full Class D license requires corrected acuity of at least twenty over forty in the better eye and at least one hundred twenty degrees of combined horizontal peripheral vision.

sec01-card-sec01-F27.front: What corrected acuity range in the better eye may qualify an applicant for a daylight-only license?
sec01-card-sec01-F27.expected_back: Someone whose better eye has corrected acuity between twenty over fifty and twenty over seventy may qualify for a license restricted to daylight driving.

sec01-card-sec01-F28.front: What paperwork may replace the counter vision screen when someone cannot take, declines, or fails it?
sec01-card-sec01-F28.expected_back: If an applicant fails, declines or cannot take the vision screen, the RMV may instead accept an original Vision Screening Certificate completed by an ophthalmologist or optometrist.

sec01-card-sec01-F29.front: Where can an applicant get a blank Vision Screening Certificate?
sec01-card-sec01-F29.expected_back: The RMV website and many eye-care providers offer the Vision Screening Certificate.

sec01-card-sec01-F30.front: What prior licensing history must you list on permit applications, license applications, and renewals?
sec01-card-sec01-F30.memory_hook: Every state and number, ten years
sec01-card-sec01-F30.expected_back: Permit applications, license applications and renewals require the applicant to list every state where they held a license during the previous ten years and all their out-of-state license numbers.

sec01-card-sec01-F31.front: Which nationwide system does the RMV check for suspensions and revocations across all fifty states?
sec01-card-sec01-F31.expected_back: The RMV checks identifying information and out-of-state license numbers against the Problem Driver Pointer System for suspension and revocation records from all fifty states.

sec01-card-sec01-F32.front: What happens if your application triggers a match in the Problem Driver Pointer System?
sec01-card-sec01-F32.expected_back: An applicant matched by the Problem Driver Pointer System cannot proceed until the out-of-state suspensions or convictions have been resolved.

sec01-card-sec01-F33.front: May a driver legally hold valid driver licenses from more than one state at the same time?
sec01-card-sec01-F33.expected_back: A driver cannot hold driver licenses from multiple states.

sec01-card-sec01-R01.front: What happens to a prior participating state's license or ID when Massachusetts issues a non-Liquor card?
sec01-card-sec01-R01.expected_back: When Massachusetts issues a driver license or an identification card other than a Liquor ID, the State-to-State program cancels a license or state identification card from another participating state.

sec01-card-sec01-R02.front: Between which two card types does a Massachusetts applicant choose?
sec01-card-sec01-R02.expected_back: An applicant chooses between a Massachusetts REAL ID card and a Standard Massachusetts card.

sec01-card-sec01-R03.front: How does the fee for a Massachusetts REAL ID compare with the fee for a Standard card?
sec01-card-sec01-R03.expected_back: The REAL ID and Standard Massachusetts card types have the same fee.

sec01-card-sec01-R04.front: What identification do you need for domestic flights or entry into certain federal buildings?
sec01-card-sec01-R04.expected_back: For domestic air travel or access to certain federal buildings, a person needs REAL ID or another acceptable identification document such as a valid passport.

sec01-card-sec01-R05.front: Which federal law does a Massachusetts REAL ID satisfy, and what two access uses does it cover?
sec01-card-sec01-R05.expected_back: A Massachusetts REAL ID card meets the federal REAL ID Act requirements and can be used for domestic flights and entry to certain federal facilities.

sec01-card-sec01-R06.front: Do Standard and REAL ID Massachusetts driver licenses grant different driving privileges?
sec01-card-sec01-R06.expected_back: Standard and REAL ID Massachusetts driver licenses grant the same driving privileges.

sec01-card-sec01-R07.front: Can a Standard Massachusetts card by itself be used for domestic flights and covered federal facilities?
sec01-card-sec01-R07.expected_back: A Standard Massachusetts card alone is not acceptable identification for the federal travel and facility purposes described in the manual.

sec01-card-sec01-R08.front: What must a Standard Massachusetts cardholder bring to board domestic flights or enter covered federal buildings?
sec01-card-sec01-R08.expected_back: A holder of a Standard Massachusetts card must use a passport or another federally acceptable identification document for domestic air travel or access to certain federal facilities.

sec01-card-sec01-R09.front: Which licensing requirements stay identical between Standard and compliant cards, and which requirements differ?
sec01-card-sec01-R09.expected_back: Age, fitness and written-test and road-test requirements are the same for Standard and REAL ID licensing, but their documentation and application requirements differ.

sec01-card-sec01-R10.front: How many driver licenses or identification cards may a person hold at one time?
sec01-card-sec01-R10.expected_back: A person may have only one driver license or identification card at a time.

sec01-card-sec01-R11.front: What four personal facts does an RMV driver license serve as primary identification to prove?
sec01-card-sec01-R11.expected_back: An RMV driver license serves as primary identification for the holder’s identity, residence, age and signature.

sec01-card-sec01-R12.front: Which two biometric or personal items from a cardholder does the RMV store in its central computer?
sec01-card-sec01-R12.expected_back: The RMV stores the license or identification holder’s photograph and signature in its central computer.

sec01-card-sec01-R13.front: How is Class D defined relative to Classes A, B, C, and M, and what vehicles are typical?
sec01-card-sec01-R13.expected_back: Class D covers a single vehicle or vehicle combination that falls outside the Class A, Class B, Class C and Class M definitions, typically an ordinary car, sport utility vehicle or family van.

sec01-card-sec01-R14.front: What is the maximum duration of a Massachusetts driver license, and on what day does it usually expire?
sec01-card-sec01-R14.expected_back: A Massachusetts driver license lasts no longer than five years and normally expires on the holder’s birthday.

sec01-card-sec01-R15.front: When can a Massachusetts REAL ID license or ID card be issued for fewer than five years?
sec01-card-sec01-R15.expected_back: A REAL ID license or identification card may have a term shorter than five years when the applicant’s authorized lawful presence is shorter.

sec01-card-sec01-R16.front: What minimum lawful-presence period is required for REAL ID, even if less time currently remains?
sec01-card-sec01-R16.expected_back: The minimum acceptable lawful-presence period for REAL ID is twelve months, although an applicant who proves that minimum period may receive the card while less time remains.

sec01-card-sec01-R17.front: How do the fee and expiration date work when a REAL ID is issued for fewer than five years?
sec01-card-sec01-R17.expected_back: For a REAL ID term shorter than five years, the fee is prorated and the expiration does not fall on the holder’s birthday.

sec01-card-sec01-R18.front: How many years is a Standard Massachusetts driver license valid?
sec01-card-sec01-R18.expected_back: A Standard Massachusetts license is valid for five years.

sec01-card-sec01-R19.front: How early before expiration can you renew a Massachusetts license or identification card?
sec01-card-sec01-R19.expected_back: A license or identification card can be renewed as early as one year before expiration.

sec01-card-sec01-R20.front: What card orientation and marking do you receive if issued or renewed before turning twenty-one?
sec01-card-sec01-R20.expected_back: A person who obtains or renews a license or identification card before turning twenty-one receives a vertical card marked Under twenty-one.

sec01-card-sec01-R21.front: Does a vertical license or ID card become invalid once the holder turns twenty-one?
sec01-card-sec01-R21.expected_back: A vertical license or identification card remains valid until its expiration even after its holder reaches twenty-one.

sec01-card-sec01-R22.front: When can a cardholder obtain a horizontal Massachusetts driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-R22.expected_back: A horizontal license can be obtained after the holder’s twenty-first birthday.

sec01-card-sec01-R23.front: What do license restrictions do, and where do their letter codes appear on the card?
sec01-card-sec01-R23.expected_back: Restrictions limit driving privileges and appear as letter codes on the front and back of the license.

sec01-card-sec01-R24.front: What driving limitation does Massachusetts license restriction code A impose?
sec01-card-sec01-R24.expected_back: Restriction code A limits use to driving with a certified driving instructor.

sec01-card-sec01-R25.front: What equipment must a driver use when license restriction code B appears on the card?
sec01-card-sec01-R25.expected_back: Restriction code B requires corrective lenses.

sec01-card-sec01-R26.front: What requirement does Massachusetts license restriction code C identify?
sec01-card-sec01-R26.expected_back: Restriction code C identifies a required mechanical aid.

sec01-card-sec01-R27.front: What type of aid does Massachusetts license restriction code D identify?
sec01-card-sec01-R27.expected_back: Restriction code D identifies a prosthetic aid or personal medical aid.

sec01-card-sec01-R28.front: When may a holder drive if Massachusetts restriction code G is on the license?
sec01-card-sec01-R28.expected_back: Restriction code G limits driving to daylight.

sec01-card-sec01-R29.front: To what purpose does Massachusetts license restriction code H limit driving?
sec01-card-sec01-R29.expected_back: Restriction code H limits driving to employment.

sec01-card-sec01-R30.front: What does Massachusetts license restriction code I denote?
sec01-card-sec01-R30.expected_back: Restriction code I denotes a Junior Operator License limitation or other restriction.

sec01-card-sec01-R31.front: What does Massachusetts license restriction code J indicate on a driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-R31.expected_back: Restriction code J denotes another restriction.

sec01-card-sec01-R32.front: How does restriction code Q limit a Massachusetts Class D driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-R32.expected_back: Restriction code Q limits a Class D license to automatic transmission.

sec01-card-sec01-R33.front: What health-monitoring requirement does Massachusetts restriction code two identify?
sec01-card-sec01-R33.expected_back: Restriction code two identifies a medical log or glucose requirement.

sec02-card-sec02-F01.front: What specialized vision device does Massachusetts license restriction code R identify?
sec02-card-sec02-F01.expected_back: Restriction code R identifies a bioptic telescoping lens.

sec02-card-sec02-F02.front: What health proof must a driver carry when restriction code S is on the license?
sec02-card-sec02-F02.expected_back: Restriction code S requires proof of blood-sugar level.

sec02-card-sec02-F03.front: What vehicle safety device does Massachusetts license restriction code T require?
sec02-card-sec02-F03.expected_back: Restriction code T identifies an ignition interlock requirement.

sec02-card-sec02-F04.front: What medical status does Massachusetts license restriction code V identify?
sec02-card-sec02-F04.expected_back: Restriction code V identifies a medical variance.

sec02-card-sec02-F05.front: What medical authorization does Massachusetts license restriction code W identify?
sec02-card-sec02-F05.expected_back: Restriction code W identifies an intrastate medical waiver.

sec02-card-sec02-F06.front: Which RMV unit evaluates physical or mental conditions affecting driving and places license restrictions?
sec02-card-sec02-F06.expected_back: Medical Affairs may restrict a license after reviewing a physical or mental condition that could affect driving ability.

sec02-card-sec02-F07.front: What restriction and driving rule apply when you pass the vision check wearing glasses or contacts?
sec02-card-sec02-F07.expected_back: A driver who passes the vision test using glasses or contacts receives restriction B and must use corrective lenses while driving.

sec02-card-sec02-F08.front: Who assigns license restrictions when a driver needs a mechanical aid or prosthetic device to drive?
sec02-card-sec02-F08.expected_back: A driver who needs a mechanical aid or prosthetic device to operate a vehicle receives restrictions from Medical Affairs.

sec02-card-sec02-F09.front: How does Medical Affairs evaluate applications, and what document might they request from your doctor?
sec02-card-sec02-F09.expected_back: Medical Affairs considers applications individually and may require a physician’s letter for medical clearance or special driving equipment.

sec02-card-sec02-F10.front: Which restriction code is automatically added to the license of every driver under eighteen?
sec02-card-sec02-F10.expected_back: Every driver younger than eighteen has the Junior Operator restriction, code I, added to the license.

sec02-card-sec02-F11.front: What licensed driver age span defines a Massachusetts Junior Operator?
sec02-card-sec02-F11.expected_back: A licensed operator between sixteen and a half and eighteen is a Junior Operator.

sec02-card-sec02-F12.front: How long must a Junior Operator applicant hold a valid learner permit before taking the road test?
sec02-card-sec02-F12.expected_back: A Junior Operator applicant must have held a valid learner permit for at least six consecutive months before the road test.

sec02-card-sec02-F13.front: What happens to a Junior Operator applicant's six-month permit clock if the permit is suspended?
sec02-card-sec02-F13.expected_back: Suspending a Junior Operator applicant’s permit invalidates it, and the required six-month period begins again after the suspension ends.

sec02-card-sec02-F14.front: How long must a Junior Operator applicant maintain a clean driving record before the road test?
sec02-card-sec02-F14.expected_back: A Junior Operator applicant needs a clean driving record for at least six consecutive months before the road test.

sec02-card-sec02-F15.front: How many classroom, behind-the-wheel, and observation hours make up RMV-approved Junior Operator driver education?
sec02-card-sec02-F15.memory_hook: Thirty class, twelve drive, six observe
sec02-card-sec02-F15.expected_back: RMV-approved Junior Operator driver education includes thirty hours of classroom instruction, twelve hours of behind-the-wheel training and six hours observing other student drivers in a car.

sec02-card-sec02-F16.front: How many additional supervised driving hours must a parent or guardian normally certify for a Junior Operator?
sec02-card-sec02-F16.expected_back: A parent or guardian must certify at least forty additional hours of supervised driving for a Junior Operator applicant.

sec02-card-sec02-F17.front: How many parent-supervised hours does the RMV accept if you complete a driver skills development program?
sec02-card-sec02-F17.memory_hook: Skills program drops hours to thirty
sec02-card-sec02-F17.expected_back: When the applicant completes a driver skills development program, the RMV accepts thirty hours of driving supervised by a parent or guardian.

sec02-card-sec02-F18.front: How long is the required parent driver-education session, and when is a parent exempt from repeating it?
sec02-card-sec02-F18.expected_back: A parent or guardian must attend two hours of instruction about the driver-education curriculum unless they have already participated within the previous five years.

sec02-card-sec02-F19.front: What step must you complete before your school sends the driver-education certificate electronically?
sec02-card-sec02-F19.expected_back: Passing the final driver-education exam allows the education certificate to be filed electronically with the RMV.

sec02-card-sec02-F20.front: Who may ride with a Junior Operator during the first six months without a qualifying adult present?
sec02-card-sec02-F20.memory_hook: No non-family peers first six months
sec02-card-sec02-F20.expected_back: For the first six months of a Junior Operator License, passengers younger than eighteen other than immediate family are prohibited unless the driver has a qualifying accompanying adult.

sec02-card-sec02-F21.front: What seat, age, experience, and license rules apply to an adult lifting the Junior passenger restriction?
sec02-card-sec02-F21.expected_back: The adult accompanying a Junior Operator under the passenger exception must sit beside the driver, be at least twenty-one, have at least one year of driving experience and hold a valid Massachusetts or other-state driver license.

sec02-card-sec02-F22.front: What two milestones end the Junior Operator passenger restriction, and which one controls?
sec02-card-sec02-F22.memory_hook: Six months or eighteen, whichever first
sec02-card-sec02-F22.expected_back: The Junior Operator passenger restriction ends when its required six-month period is completed or when the driver turns eighteen, whichever comes first.

sec02-card-sec02-F23.front: How does a license suspension affect a Junior Operator's six-month passenger-restriction countdown?
sec02-card-sec02-F23.memory_hook: Suspension freezes passenger clock, finish later
sec02-card-sec02-F23.expected_back: A license suspension pauses the Junior Operator passenger-restriction clock, and after reinstatement the remaining period must be completed unless the driver has turned eighteen.

sec02-card-sec02-F24.front: Between what late-night hours does the Junior Operator nighttime driving restriction apply?
sec02-card-sec02-F24.expected_back: The Junior Operator nighttime driving restriction covers twelve thirty in the morning through five in the morning.

sec02-card-sec02-F25.front: Who may accompany a Junior Operator to drive legally during restricted late-night hours?
sec02-card-sec02-F25.expected_back: A parent or legal guardian may accompany a Junior Operator during the restricted nighttime period.

sec02-card-sec02-F26.front: What criminal charge can result from violating the Junior Operator nighttime driving restriction?
sec02-card-sec02-F26.expected_back: Violating the Junior Operator nighttime restriction may lead to a criminal charge of operating without a license.

sec02-card-sec02-F27.front: During which two thirty-minute or one-hour windows is the Junior night curfew enforced only after another stop?
sec02-card-sec02-F27.memory_hook: Twelve-thirty to one, four to five
sec02-card-sec02-F27.expected_back: During twelve thirty to one in the morning and four to five in the morning, the Junior Operator nighttime restriction is enforced only after a lawful stop for another offense.

sec02-card-sec02-F28.front: Does secondary enforcement make solo Junior driving between twelve-thirty and one or four and five legal?
sec02-card-sec02-F28.expected_back: Secondary enforcement during parts of the Junior Operator nighttime restriction does not make unaccompanied driving during those intervals lawful.

sec02-card-sec02-F29.front: What suspension lengths apply to first, second, and later Junior passenger or night restriction violations?
sec02-card-sec02-F29.expected_back: A passenger-restriction or nighttime-restriction violation brings a sixty-day suspension for the first offense, one hundred eighty days for the second and one year for later offenses.

sec02-card-sec02-F30.front: What course is required after a second or subsequent Junior passenger or nighttime violation?
sec02-card-sec02-F30.expected_back: A second or later passenger-restriction or nighttime-restriction offense also requires Driver Attitudinal Retraining.

sec02-card-sec02-F31.front: How does a Junior passenger or night suspension combine with other penalties from the same stop?
sec02-card-sec02-F31.expected_back: The suspension for a Junior Operator passenger or nighttime restriction violation is added to other penalties and requirements associated with the same incident.

sec02-card-sec02-F32.front: May a Junior Operator drive any vehicle that requires a commercial driver license?
sec02-card-sec02-F32.expected_back: A Junior Operator may not drive a vehicle that requires a commercial driver license.

sec02-card-sec02-F33.front: What extra suspension hits an offender under eighteen for specified alcohol- or drug-related driving offenses?
sec02-card-sec02-F33.expected_back: For specified driving offenses involving alcohol or drugs, an offender younger than eighteen receives an additional one-year suspension.

sec02-card-sec02-F34.front: What extra suspension applies to drivers aged eighteen to twenty-one for specified alcohol or drug driving offenses?
sec02-card-sec02-F34.memory_hook: Eighteen to twenty-one adds one-eighty days
sec02-card-sec02-F34.expected_back: For the specified alcohol- or drug-related driving offenses described here, an offender from eighteen to twenty-one receives an additional one-hundred-eighty-day suspension.

sec02-card-sec02-F35.front: When can a suspended Junior Operator finally upgrade to an unrestricted full license?
sec02-card-sec02-F35.expected_back: A Junior Operator cannot obtain a full license until reaching eighteen and completing the suspension imposed while driving with the Junior Operator License.

sec02-card-sec02-R01.front: What additional suspensions hit a Junior Operator for a first and a repeat drag-racing offense?
sec02-card-sec02-R01.memory_hook: Drag racing adds one, three years
sec02-card-sec02-R01.expected_back: A Junior Operator faces an additional one-year suspension for a first drag-racing offense and three years for a later drag-racing offense.

sec02-card-sec02-R02.front: What license suspension lengths apply to a Junior Operator's first and subsequent speeding offenses?
sec02-card-sec02-R02.memory_hook: First speeding ninety days, next year
sec02-card-sec02-R02.expected_back: A Junior Operator’s first speeding offense brings a ninety-day suspension, and a later speeding offense brings a one-year suspension.

sec02-card-sec02-R03.front: When is a driver younger than eighteen permitted to use a mobile electronic device while driving?
sec02-card-sec02-R03.expected_back: A driver younger than eighteen may use a mobile electronic device while operating a vehicle only to report an emergency.

sec02-card-sec02-R04.front: Do REAL ID and Standard Massachusetts applicants bring the exact same identification documents?
sec02-card-sec02-R04.expected_back: Permit, license and identification applicants must provide identification documents, with different requirements for REAL ID and Standard cards.

sec02-card-sec02-R05.front: How many documents proving lawful presence in the United States must a REAL ID applicant present?
sec02-card-sec02-R05.expected_back: A REAL ID applicant must present one document proving lawful presence in the United States.

sec02-card-sec02-R06.front: How many documents proving Massachusetts residence must a REAL ID applicant bring?
sec02-card-sec02-R06.memory_hook: REAL ID needs two residency proofs
sec02-card-sec02-R06.expected_back: A REAL ID applicant must present two documents proving Massachusetts residence.

sec02-card-sec02-R07.front: How can a REAL ID applicant satisfy the Social Security document requirement?
sec02-card-sec02-R07.expected_back: For the REAL ID Social Security requirement, an applicant presents proof of the Social Security Number or a denial notice accompanied by a non-United States passport, visa and I-ninety-four.

sec02-card-sec02-R08.front: How many documents proving identity and date of birth does a Standard Massachusetts card applicant need?
sec02-card-sec02-R08.expected_back: Depending on the documents selected, a Standard card applicant needs one or two documents proving identity and date of birth.

sec02-card-sec02-R09.front: How many documents showing Massachusetts residence must a Standard card applicant provide?
sec02-card-sec02-R09.expected_back: A Standard card applicant must provide one document showing Massachusetts residence.

sec02-card-sec02-R10.front: How can a Standard card applicant satisfy the Social Security requirement without bringing a paper card?
sec02-card-sec02-R10.expected_back: A Standard card applicant may meet the Social Security requirement with a number that validates electronically.

sec02-card-sec02-R11.front: Which four items let a Standard card applicant use a Social Security denial notice?
sec02-card-sec02-R11.expected_back: A Standard card applicant may use a Social Security denial notice with a non-United States passport, visa and I-ninety-four to meet the Social Security requirement.

sec02-card-sec02-R12.front: For which card type may eligible applicants use the No Social Security Number Affidavit, and where is it barred?
sec02-card-sec02-R12.expected_back: The No Social Security Number Affidavit option is limited to certain customers with specified documents and Standard driver licenses, and cannot be used for Massachusetts identification cards.

sec02-card-sec02-R13.front: From what source must identification evidence come, and who decides whether it is satisfactory?
sec02-card-sec02-R13.expected_back: Identification evidence must come from the RMV Acceptable Identification Document list and be satisfactory to the RMV.

sec02-card-sec02-R14.front: Can the RMV require identification documents again when you already hold a Massachusetts permit, license, or ID?
sec02-card-sec02-R14.memory_hook: Each new credential may require proofs
sec02-card-sec02-R14.expected_back: The RMV may require identification evidence for each different document applied for even when the applicant already has a Massachusetts permit, license or identification card.

sec02-card-sec02-R15.front: Unless instructions state otherwise, in what form must identification documents be presented?
sec02-card-sec02-R15.expected_back: Identification documents must be originals unless the instructions specify otherwise.

sec02-card-sec02-R16.front: Which two altered or duplicated forms of identification documents will the RMV reject?
sec02-card-sec02-R16.expected_back: The RMV does not accept photocopies or laminated identification documents.

sec02-card-sec02-R17.front: How can an applicant prepare online before visiting an RMV Service Center?
sec02-card-sec02-R17.expected_back: An applicant can begin online and identify the documents they plan to bring to the RMV.

sec02-card-sec02-R18.front: Can foreign diplomats, family members, or staff holding a State Department driver license get a Massachusetts license?
sec02-card-sec02-R18.expected_back: Foreign diplomats and other foreign officials, their family members and their assistants or employees with a United States Department of State driver license cannot obtain a Massachusetts driver license.

sec02-card-sec02-R19.front: What extra paperwork must an applicant submit when their visa requires an accompanying form?
sec02-card-sec02-R19.expected_back: An applicant whose visa requires an accompanying form must also submit that form, such as the I-twenty required for the student visas listed in the manual.

sec02-card-sec02-R20.front: Why does the RMV direct applicants to check its current identification information before applying?
sec02-card-sec02-R20.expected_back: Identification requirements may change, so the RMV directs applicants to its current identification information.

sec02-card-sec02-R21.front: Does needing extra research or manual review during an electronic document check mean your application was denied?
sec02-card-sec02-R21.expected_back: An electronic identification-document check that requires extra research or manual review does not itself mean the application has been denied.

sec02-card-sec02-R22.front: How long does additional identification verification usually take, and what is the rare upper limit?
sec02-card-sec02-R22.memory_hook: Three to five days, max twenty
sec02-card-sec02-R22.expected_back: Additional identification verification is generally resolved within three to five business days but can rarely take as long as twenty days.

sec02-card-sec02-R23.front: For which RMV card transactions must applicants satisfy the Social Security requirement?
sec02-card-sec02-R23.expected_back: Applicants must satisfy the Social Security requirement for a permit, license or identification card, including replacements and renewals.

sec02-card-sec02-R24.front: How does the RMV verify an applicant's Social Security Number?
sec02-card-sec02-R24.expected_back: The RMV attempts to validate an applicant’s Social Security Number using Social Security Administration computer records.

sec02-card-sec02-R25.front: How recent must a written Social Security denial notice be when presented to the RMV?
sec02-card-sec02-R25.expected_back: An applicant denied a Social Security Number must present the written denial notice issued no more than sixty days earlier.

sec02-card-sec02-R26.front: Alongside a recent Social Security denial notice, what three immigration documents are required?
sec02-card-sec02-R26.memory_hook: Visa proof, arrival record, foreign passport
sec02-card-sec02-R26.expected_back: The Social Security denial route also requires current visa-status proof, an I-ninety-four arrival-and-departure record and the applicant’s current non-United States passport.

sec02-card-sec02-R27.front: What may an applicant without a Social Security Number who is ineligible for one submit for a Standard license?
sec02-card-sec02-R27.expected_back: An applicant without a Social Security Number who cannot apply for one may submit a No Social Security Number Affidavit for a Standard driver license.

sec02-card-sec02-R28.front: Within how many days of receiving a written RMV denial may an applicant file an appeal?
sec02-card-sec02-R28.expected_back: An applicant may appeal a permit, license or identification-card denial within ten days of receiving the RMV’s written denial.

sec02-card-sec02-R29.front: Does pursuing an informal RMV review extend the ten-day deadline to appeal a denial?
sec02-card-sec02-R29.memory_hook: Informal review never extends ten days
sec02-card-sec02-R29.expected_back: Time spent on an informal review does not extend the ten-day deadline for appealing an RMV denial.

sec02-card-sec02-R30.front: Where does a formal application-denial appeal go, and what payment is required?
sec02-card-sec02-R30.expected_back: A formal application-denial appeal goes to the designated insurance Board of Appeals and requires a fifty-dollar check or money order.

sec02-card-sec02-R31.front: What credential must every applicant obtain before applying for a Massachusetts driver license?
sec02-card-sec02-R31.expected_back: An applicant must obtain a learner permit before applying for a driver license.

sec02-card-sec02-R32.front: What five items or exams are required to obtain a Massachusetts learner permit?
sec02-card-sec02-R32.expected_back: Obtaining a learner permit requires an application, identification, the fee, a vision exam and a learner-permit exam.

sec02-card-sec02-R33.front: What two final steps turn a learner permit into a Massachusetts driver license?
sec02-card-sec02-R33.expected_back: A learner permit becomes a driver license only after the road test is passed and every license fee has been paid.

sec02-card-sec02-R34.front: What must an applicant do if their Massachusetts learner permit expires before licensing?
sec02-card-sec02-R34.expected_back: When a learner permit expires, the applicant must take the learner-permit exam again and pay the required fees.

sec03-card-sec03-F01.front: Why does the RMV tell applicants to use its own website instead of look-alike third-party sites?
sec03-card-sec03-F01.expected_back: The RMV directs applicants to use its own website because similar third-party sites may add fees or put personal and financial information at risk.

sec03-card-sec03-F02.front: What is the minimum age to apply for a Massachusetts Class D learner permit?
sec03-card-sec03-F02.expected_back: A Class D learner-permit applicant must be at least sixteen.

sec03-card-sec03-F03.front: What two broad subject areas does the Massachusetts learner-permit exam measure?
sec03-card-sec03-F03.expected_back: The learner-permit exam tests Massachusetts motor-vehicle laws and safe-driving practices.

sec03-card-sec03-F04.front: What minimum age must the accompanying licensed operator be when you practice on a learner permit?
sec03-card-sec03-F04.expected_back: A learner permit permits practice driving with a licensed operator who is at least twenty-one.

sec03-card-sec03-F05.front: Up to how many years can a Massachusetts learner permit remain valid?
sec03-card-sec03-F05.expected_back: A learner permit can remain valid for up to two years.

sec03-card-sec03-F06.front: Which future licensing fees may an applicant prepay while applying for a learner permit?
sec03-card-sec03-F06.expected_back: Road-test and license fees may be prepaid when applying for the learner permit.

sec03-card-sec03-F07.front: What happens after you pass your road test if all required fees were already paid?
sec03-card-sec03-F07.expected_back: When the required fees have been paid, the license is sent automatically after a successful road test without another RMV Service Center visit.

sec03-card-sec03-F08.front: How do you submit a learner-permit application, and what step can be completed beforehand?
sec03-card-sec03-F08.expected_back: An applicant submits the learner-permit application during a reserved RMV Service Center visit and may prepare the application online beforehand.

sec03-card-sec03-F09.front: Who must sign a learner-permit application when the applicant is younger than eighteen?
sec03-card-sec03-F09.memory_hook: Parent or guardian signs under eighteen
sec03-card-sec03-F09.expected_back: A learner-permit applicant younger than eighteen must have a parent or guardian sign the application.

sec03-card-sec03-F10.front: What health or medical facts must an applicant disclose on the learner-permit application?
sec03-card-sec03-F10.memory_hook: Disclose conditions or medications affecting driving
sec03-card-sec03-F10.expected_back: The application requires disclosure of conditions or medications that could affect the applicant’s ability to drive.

sec03-card-sec03-F11.front: How much is the Massachusetts learner-permit exam fee?
sec03-card-sec03-F11.expected_back: The learner-permit exam fee is thirty dollars.

sec03-card-sec03-F12.front: Which two personal identifiers does the RMV capture electronically from a permit applicant?
sec03-card-sec03-F12.expected_back: The RMV electronically captures the permit applicant’s photograph and signature.

sec03-card-sec03-F13.front: What two options satisfy the vision requirement when applying for a learner permit?
sec03-card-sec03-F13.expected_back: A permit applicant must pass the service-center vision test or submit an RMV vision-screening certificate from a medical practitioner.

sec03-card-sec03-F14.front: After submitting your application at the RMV, where can you take the learner-permit exam?
sec03-card-sec03-F14.expected_back: After submitting the application, an applicant can take the learner-permit exam at the service center or online.

sec03-card-sec03-F15.front: What can you do if you pass the permit exam online without access to a printer?
sec03-card-sec03-F15.expected_back: An applicant who passes online but cannot print the learner permit may ask the RMV to print and mail it.

sec03-card-sec03-F16.front: What kind of privilege does a learner permit grant, and for what purpose is it not intended?
sec03-card-sec03-F16.expected_back: The learner permit grants conditional driving privileges and is not intended as travel identification.

sec03-card-sec03-F17.front: Which five specific topic areas are covered on the Massachusetts learner-permit exam?
sec03-card-sec03-F17.expected_back: Learner-permit exam topics include alcohol misuse, suspensions, Junior Operator violations, road rules and road-sign identification.

sec03-card-sec03-F18.front: How do automated testing stations at full-service RMV centers present permit-exam questions?
sec03-card-sec03-F18.expected_back: Automated testing stations at full-service centers display permit-exam questions on video-screen kiosks.

sec03-card-sec03-F19.front: Are driver manuals or reference notes allowed during the permit exam or inside the testing area?
sec03-card-sec03-F19.expected_back: Driver manuals and other reference materials are prohibited during the learner-permit exam and in the testing area.

sec03-card-sec03-F20.front: May you wear or use an electronic device for any purpose during the learner-permit exam?
sec03-card-sec03-F20.expected_back: Wearing or using an electronic device during the learner-permit exam is prohibited regardless of the device’s purpose.

sec03-card-sec03-F21.front: Under what single condition may headphones or audio gear be worn during the permit exam?
sec03-card-sec03-F21.expected_back: Headphones and other audio devices may be worn during the permit exam only when being used for an audio exam.

sec03-card-sec03-F22.front: For what two reasons may an applicant keep a hat on during the learner-permit exam?
sec03-card-sec03-F22.expected_back: A hat may be worn during the permit exam only for a medical or religious reason.

sec03-card-sec03-F23.front: How does the RMV classify using a manual, reference sheet, or electronic device during the permit exam?
sec03-card-sec03-F23.expected_back: Using a manual, other reference or electronic device during the permit exam counts as cheating.

sec03-card-sec03-F24.front: What two immediate consequences follow being caught cheating or attempting to cheat on the permit exam?
sec03-card-sec03-F24.expected_back: Being caught cheating or attempting to cheat causes an exam failure and further investigation.

sec03-card-sec03-F25.front: How long is someone found responsible for permit-exam cheating barred from holding any license or permit?
sec03-card-sec03-F25.expected_back: A person found responsible for exam cheating cannot hold any driver license or permit for sixty days.

sec03-card-sec03-F26.front: What exam option may an applicant request when English is not their primary language?
sec03-card-sec03-F26.expected_back: An applicant whose primary language is not English may request a learner-permit exam in a foreign language.

sec03-card-sec03-F27.front: Which six Class D permit exam languages make up the opening A-through-C group before Chinese?
sec03-card-sec03-F27.memory_hook: Arabic, Albanian, Armenian, Burmese, Khmer, Creole
sec03-card-sec03-F27.expected_back: The listed Class D exam languages include Arabic, Albanian, Armenian, Burmese, Cambodian Khmer and Cape Verdean Creole.

sec03-card-sec03-F28.front: Which six Class D permit exam languages span the two C-scripts plus the F and G options?
sec03-card-sec03-F28.memory_hook: Both Chinese, Farsi, French, German, Greek
sec03-card-sec03-F28.expected_back: The listed Class D exam languages include traditional Chinese, simplified Chinese, Farsi, French, German and Greek.

sec03-card-sec03-F29.front: After Greek, which six Class D permit exam languages fall in the group ending with I and J?
sec03-card-sec03-F29.memory_hook: Hindi, Gujarati, Haitian, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese
sec03-card-sec03-F29.expected_back: The listed Class D exam languages include Hindi, Gujarati, Haitian Creole, Hungarian, Italian and Japanese.

sec03-card-sec03-F30.front: Which six Class D permit exam languages start with the letters K, L, N, and P?
sec03-card-sec03-F30.memory_hook: Korean, Kiswahili, Laotian, Nepali, Pashto, Polish
sec03-card-sec03-F30.expected_back: The listed Class D exam languages include Korean, Kiswahili, Laotian, Nepali, Pashto and Polish.

sec03-card-sec03-R01.front: Which six Class D permit exam languages fall in the R-and-S group ending with Tagalog Filipino?
sec03-card-sec03-R01.memory_hook: Russian, Portuguese, Serbo-Croatian, Somali, Spanish, Tagalog
sec03-card-sec03-R01.expected_back: The listed Class D exam languages include Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, Serbo-Croatian in Latin script, Somali, Spanish and Tagalog Filipino.

sec03-card-sec03-R02.front: Which six Class D permit exam languages close out the list from T, U, and V to sign language?
sec03-card-sec03-R02.memory_hook: Turkish, Thai, Ukrainian, Urdu, Vietnamese, ASL
sec03-card-sec03-R02.expected_back: The listed Class D exam languages include Turkish, Thai, Ukrainian, Urdu, Vietnamese and American Sign Language.

sec03-card-sec03-R03.front: Where are audio permit exams offered, and how are questions and choices delivered?
sec03-card-sec03-R03.expected_back: Audio exams are offered both at automated testing stations and online, with a voice reading questions and possible answers through headphones.

sec03-card-sec03-R04.front: In which languages are Class D audio permit exams available?
sec03-card-sec03-R04.expected_back: Class D audio exams are available in the languages listed for the Class D exam.

sec03-card-sec03-R05.front: Do you need advance scheduling or disability paperwork to choose an audio permit exam?
sec03-card-sec03-R05.expected_back: Anyone may choose an audio exam without scheduling it in advance or providing extra eligibility documents.

sec03-card-sec03-R06.front: What gear should you bring if you want an audio exam at an RMV Service Center?
sec03-card-sec03-R06.expected_back: An applicant wanting audio at an RMV Service Center should bring headphones to connect to the automated station’s universal headphone splitter.

sec03-card-sec03-R07.front: What kind of disability can support requesting a reasonable testing accommodation from the RMV?
sec03-card-sec03-R07.memory_hook: Cognitive or physical disability preventing standard
sec03-card-sec03-R07.expected_back: A cognitive or physical disability that prevents a standard exam may support a request for a reasonable testing accommodation.

sec03-card-sec03-R08.front: What two examples of reasonable permit-exam accommodations are named in the manual?
sec03-card-sec03-R08.expected_back: Possible testing accommodations include additional time or a designated RMV employee reading the exam aloud.

sec03-card-sec03-R09.front: What four pieces of information should an applicant include when requesting a testing accommodation?
sec03-card-sec03-R09.expected_back: An accommodation request should include the applicant’s name, telephone number, requested accommodation and preferred service center.

sec03-card-sec03-R10.front: What supporting paperwork may the RMV require before granting a testing accommodation?
sec03-card-sec03-R10.expected_back: The RMV may require disability-related documentation suited to the condition and the testing accommodation requested.

sec03-card-sec03-R11.front: How does an applicant find out whether a testing-accommodation request was granted?
sec03-card-sec03-R11.expected_back: The RMV informs the applicant whether the testing-accommodation request has been approved.

sec03-card-sec03-R12.front: What three details do you give to request an American Sign Language interpreter, and what happens next?
sec03-card-sec03-R12.expected_back: To request an American Sign Language interpreter, an applicant gives the RMV their name, telephone number and preferred service center, after which the RMV contacts them to schedule the exam and request the interpreter.

sec03-card-sec03-R13.front: When must a learner carry their permit, and until what milestone?
sec03-card-sec03-R13.expected_back: A learner must carry the permit whenever driving until a Junior Operator License or full license is earned.

sec03-card-sec03-R14.front: What seat, age, license, and experience rules apply to the adult supervising a Class D permit driver?
sec03-card-sec03-R14.expected_back: A Class D permit driver must have a licensed operator in the adjacent passenger seat who is at least twenty-one, has a valid Massachusetts or other-state license and has at least one year of driving experience.

sec03-card-sec03-R15.front: Who must accompany a permit driver under eighteen between midnight and five in the morning?
sec03-card-sec03-R15.expected_back: Between midnight and five in the morning, a permit driver younger than eighteen must have a parent or legal guardian along who holds a valid operator license and has at least a year of experience driving.

sec03-card-sec03-R16.front: When may a Massachusetts Class D learner permit be used to drive in another state?
sec03-card-sec03-R16.expected_back: A Massachusetts Class D permit may be used to drive in another state only when that state’s laws allow it.

sec03-card-sec03-R17.front: Where must drivers younger than eighteen take professional driving lessons?
sec03-card-sec03-R17.expected_back: Drivers younger than eighteen must take professional driving lessons through a high school or driving school.

sec03-card-sec03-R18.front: Who licenses and monitors every Massachusetts professional driving school, including high-school programs?
sec03-card-sec03-R18.expected_back: Every Massachusetts professional driving school, including a public or private high-school program, must be licensed and monitored by the RMV.

sec03-card-sec03-R19.front: What can an applicant ask to inspect if unsure about a driving school's legitimacy?
sec03-card-sec03-R19.expected_back: An applicant uncertain about a driving school’s credentials can ask to see its RMV license certificate.

sec03-card-sec03-R20.front: What education, exam, and filing steps must applicants aged sixteen and a half to eighteen complete?
sec03-card-sec03-R20.expected_back: An applicant from sixteen and a half to eighteen must complete an approved driver-education program and final exam and have the certificate electronically filed with the RMV.

sec03-card-sec03-R21.front: How many supervised practice hours are required normally versus after a driver skills development program?
sec03-card-sec03-R21.expected_back: The supervised-driving requirement is forty hours, or thirty hours after completion of a driver skills development program.

sec03-card-sec03-R22.front: How much driver-education curriculum must a parent or guardian attend, and what is the five-year rule?
sec03-card-sec03-R22.memory_hook: Two hours unless within five years
sec03-card-sec03-R22.expected_back: A parent or guardian must attend two hours of the driver-education curriculum unless they attended during the previous five years.

sec03-card-sec03-R23.front: What must you hold before scheduling a Massachusetts road test?
sec03-card-sec03-R23.expected_back: A learner permit of the correct class is required before a road test can be scheduled.

sec03-card-sec03-R24.front: What is the maximum number of Class D road tests an applicant may attempt in twelve months?
sec03-card-sec03-R24.expected_back: A Class D applicant may attempt no more than six road tests during a twelve-month period.

sec03-card-sec03-R25.front: How much notice avoids an extra fee when canceling or rescheduling a road test?
sec03-card-sec03-R25.expected_back: Canceling or rescheduling a road test with more than seventy-two hours of notice carries no additional fee.

sec03-card-sec03-R26.front: When is a driving instructor allowed to sponsor an applicant's road test?
sec03-card-sec03-R26.expected_back: A driving instructor may sponsor a road test only when the instructor’s school is RMV-certified.

sec03-card-sec03-R27.front: How many days must pass after a failed or missed road test before taking another one?
sec03-card-sec03-R27.expected_back: After a road-test failure or a missed appointment, an applicant must wait at least fourteen days before another road test.

sec03-card-sec03-R28.front: What two consequences hit an applicant who arrives late for a scheduled road test?
sec03-card-sec03-R28.expected_back: An applicant who arrives late for the road test will not be tested and must pay the road-test fee.

sec03-card-sec03-R29.front: What financial requirement must be met before scheduling a new road test?
sec03-card-sec03-R29.expected_back: All outstanding fees must be paid before a new road test is scheduled.

sec04-card-sec04-F01.front: What happens to scheduled Massachusetts road tests during a governor-declared state of emergency — statewide versus regional?
sec04-card-sec04-F01.expected_back: A governor-declared state of emergency automatically cancels road tests, with a regional declaration canceling tests only in the affected region.

sec04-card-sec04-F02.front: If an examiner cancels your road test due to unsafe weather, what happens to your fee when rescheduling?
sec04-card-sec04-F02.expected_back: An examiner may cancel a road test because of unsafe weather, and an applicant whose test is canceled for that reason may reschedule without an added fee.

sec04-card-sec04-F03.front: Besides failing on the road, which five arrival, vehicle, or sponsor missteps still trigger the road-test fee?
sec04-card-sec04-F03.expected_back: Failing, arriving unprepared, having an unacceptable vehicle, lacking a qualified sponsor, missing or arriving late for a road test can each cause the road-test fee to be charged.

sec04-card-sec04-F04.front: Canceling or rescheduling a Massachusetts road test with less than how many hours of notice triggers the fee?
sec04-card-sec04-F04.expected_back: Canceling or rescheduling a road test with less than seventy-two hours of notice causes the road-test fee to be charged.

sec04-card-sec04-F05.front: What may an examiner do if either the road-test applicant OR the sponsor appears impaired by alcohol or another substance?
sec04-card-sec04-F05.expected_back: An examiner may reject a road test when the applicant or sponsor shows signs of impairment by alcohol or another substance.

sec04-card-sec04-F06.front: Which two odors — coming from which four sources — let an examiner reject a road test on the spot?
sec04-card-sec04-F06.expected_back: An examiner may reject a road test when alcohol or cannabis odor comes from the applicant, sponsor, their clothes or the vehicle.

sec04-card-sec04-F07.front: Why can bringing unsupervised children or pets cancel your road test — and how do service versus emotional-support animals differ?
sec04-card-sec04-F07.expected_back: Children, babies or animals that cannot be left supervised can cause road-test rejection, although trained service animals are allowed and emotional-support animals are not.

sec04-card-sec04-F38.front: Roughly how many minutes before your scheduled road-test slot should you arrive?
sec04-card-sec04-F38.expected_back: Applicants should arrive about fifteen minutes before their road-test appointment.

sec04-card-sec04-F39.front: Must you turn off backup cameras or parking assist for a road test, and how does the examiner judge you?
sec04-card-sec04-F39.expected_back: Specialized features such as cameras or parking assistance need not be disabled for a road test, but the applicant’s driving ability without sole reliance on them is still tested.

sec04-card-sec04-F40.front: What gets added to your license if you require adaptive equipment or specialized vehicle features to drive?
sec04-card-sec04-F40.expected_back: Necessary adaptive equipment or a need to use specialized features results in a mechanical or software aid restriction on the license.

sec04-card-sec04-F41.front: Which three people normally ride inside the vehicle during a road test, and what fourth person may join when permitted?
sec04-card-sec04-F41.expected_back: The applicant, examiner and sponsor are the usual road-test occupants, with a language interpreter also permitted when allowed.

sec04-card-sec04-R01.front: Draw the exact line on road-test cabin occupants between trained service animals, pets, emotional-support animals, and children?
sec04-card-sec04-R01.expected_back: Road-test occupants may include a trained service animal, but not children, pets or emotional-support animals.

sec04-card-sec04-R02.front: When may an applicant speak with their sponsor or interpreter once the road test is underway?
sec04-card-sec04-R02.expected_back: The applicant and sponsor or interpreter may converse during the road test only with the examiner’s authorization.

sec04-card-sec04-R03.front: How can a deaf or hard-of-hearing applicant arrange an interpreter for their Massachusetts road test?
sec04-card-sec04-R03.expected_back: A deaf or hard-of-hearing applicant can request a road test with an interpreter through the RMV’s accommodation process.

sec04-card-sec04-R04.front: What two preparation steps happen before a deaf or hard-of-hearing applicant's road test starts?
sec04-card-sec04-R04.expected_back: Before a deaf or hard-of-hearing applicant’s test, the examiner explains communication and test elements, and written test information is supplied for review with the interpreter.

sec04-card-sec04-R05.front: If you need to clarify something with the examiner during a road test, how should you handle it?
sec04-card-sec04-R05.expected_back: A road-test applicant with a question may pull over when safe and communicate with the examiner.

sec04-card-sec04-R06.front: What policy does the Massachusetts RMV enforce toward violent or abusive behavior by applicants or sponsors?
sec04-card-sec04-R06.expected_back: The RMV applies zero tolerance to violent or abusive conduct by road-test applicants and sponsors.

sec04-card-sec04-F08.front: What extra signature must appear on a Class D road-test application when the applicant is under eighteen?
sec04-card-sec04-F08.expected_back: A Class D road-test applicant needs a completed application with parent or guardian consent when younger than eighteen.

sec04-card-sec04-F09.front: What must you disclose on the road-test application regarding health or prescriptions — and what clearance is needed beforehand?
sec04-card-sec04-F09.expected_back: The road-test application requires disclosure of a condition or medication that could affect driving, and an affected applicant must obtain physician clearance before the test.

sec04-card-sec04-F10.front: When a road-test application discloses a medical condition, which two paths can the examiner take?
sec04-card-sec04-F10.expected_back: The examiner reviews a disclosed medical condition and may approve the application or send it to Medical Affairs.

sec04-card-sec04-F11.front: In what physical form must a Class D road-test applicant bring their learner permit?
sec04-card-sec04-F11.expected_back: A Class D road-test applicant must bring the printed learner permit.

sec04-card-sec04-F12.front: What document must your road-test sponsor physically carry to the appointment?
sec04-card-sec04-F12.expected_back: A road-test sponsor must carry a current valid license.

sec04-card-sec04-F13.front: What vehicle standards and document must the applicant bring for the test car?
sec04-card-sec04-F13.expected_back: The applicant must supply a properly equipped, legally registered test vehicle and its registration certificate.

sec04-card-sec04-F14.front: How many consecutive months of clean driving must an applicant under eighteen hold right before applying for a road test?
sec04-card-sec04-F14.expected_back: An applicant younger than eighteen needs six consecutive months of clean driving immediately before applying for the road test.

sec04-card-sec04-F15.front: Which three categories of incidents, suspensions, or convictions reset a junior applicant's six-month clean-driving clock?
sec04-card-sec04-F15.expected_back: For a junior road-test applicant, surchargeable incidents, a permit suspension for drug- or alcohol-related motor-vehicle violations, or a drug- or alcohol-law conviction can interrupt the clean-record requirement.

sec04-card-sec04-F16.front: If a disqualifying event hits a junior applicant AFTER booking a road test, what happens — and what age exception applies?
sec04-card-sec04-F16.expected_back: If a disqualifying event interrupts a junior applicant’s clean record after booking but before the test, the test cannot proceed until a new six-month clean period is established unless the applicant turns eighteen first.

sec04-card-sec04-F17.front: Does holding a valid foreign driver license exempt a Class D road-test applicant from bringing a sponsor?
sec04-card-sec04-F17.expected_back: Every Class D road-test applicant needs a sponsor, including an applicant who has a valid foreign driver license.

sec04-card-sec04-F18.front: What minimum age, driving experience, and license origin qualify someone to be a Class D road-test sponsor?
sec04-card-sec04-F18.expected_back: A Class D sponsor must be at least twenty-one, have at least a year of driving experience and hold a valid license issued by their home state.

sec04-card-sec04-F19.front: May someone whose driver license was issued by a foreign country act as your road-test sponsor?
sec04-card-sec04-F19.expected_back: A person holding a foreign driver license cannot serve as a road-test sponsor.

sec04-card-sec04-F20.front: Without special RMV Road Test Program approval, how many different applicants may one driver sponsor in a year?
sec04-card-sec04-F20.expected_back: Without RMV Road Test Program approval, one operator cannot sponsor more than three different applicants in a year.

sec04-card-sec04-F21.front: What happens if an examiner deems your test vehicle unsafe, and what two compliance items are required?
sec04-card-sec04-F21.expected_back: The examiner cancels a road test if the vehicle is considered unsafe, and the applicant must show its registration and have it properly inspected.

sec04-card-sec04-F22.front: Where inside the test vehicle must seats exist for the examiner and for the sponsor?
sec04-card-sec04-F22.expected_back: The test vehicle needs a seat beside the driver for the examiner and a rear seat behind the driver for the sponsor.

sec04-card-sec04-F23.front: Can your sponsor ride in the cargo bed of a two-passenger pickup truck during a road test?
sec04-card-sec04-F23.expected_back: A sponsor cannot ride in the bed of a two-passenger pickup during the road test.

sec04-card-sec04-F24.front: Whether manual lever or electric button, what access requirement applies to the test car's parking brake?
sec04-card-sec04-F24.expected_back: The test vehicle’s parking brake must be accessible to the examiner for an emergency stop, whether it uses a manual control or an electric button.

sec04-card-sec04-F25.front: Who makes the final call on parking-brake accessibility — and what cabin placement avoids trouble?
sec04-card-sec04-F25.expected_back: The examiner decides whether the parking brake is accessible, and a centrally placed parking brake helps avoid an access problem.

sec04-card-sec04-F26.front: Is the road-test fee charged if your scheduled test cannot run SOLELY because the examiner cannot reach the braking system?
sec04-card-sec04-F26.expected_back: No fee is charged for a scheduled road test prevented solely because the examiner cannot access the braking system.

sec04-card-sec04-F27.front: What two special items must a driving-instruction vehicle carry?
sec04-card-sec04-F27.expected_back: Driving-instruction vehicles need a second foot brake for the instructor or examiner and the required signage.

sec04-card-sec04-F28.front: What happens if your vehicle's parking brake fails the legally required pre-drive holding check?
sec04-card-sec04-F28.expected_back: A road test cannot proceed when the vehicle’s parking brake fails the legally required test.

sec04-card-sec04-F29.front: Why can a working parking brake still get a road-test car rejected?
sec04-card-sec04-F29.expected_back: A vehicle can be rejected when its parking brake is too far from the examiner to reach easily during an emergency.

sec04-card-sec04-F30.front: What three dollar coverage minimums must an out-of-state test vehicle prove to meet Massachusetts standards?
sec04-card-sec04-F30.expected_back: For an out-of-state-registered test vehicle, proof must show Massachusetts minimum insurance limits of twenty-five thousand and fifty thousand dollars for bodily injury and thirty thousand dollars for property damage.

sec04-card-sec04-F31.front: Which two documents stating coverage limits can prove insurance for a road-test vehicle?
sec04-card-sec04-F31.expected_back: An insurance policy or certificate stating the coverage limits may serve as proof of test-vehicle insurance.

sec04-card-sec04-F32.front: What two documents — and what dual permission — are required to take a road test in a rented vehicle?
sec04-card-sec04-F32.expected_back: A rented test vehicle requires the rental agreement and a rental-company letter on company letterhead authorizing both applicant and sponsor to use it for the road test.

sec04-card-sec04-F33.front: Do you need rental-company authorization letters when bringing a leased vehicle to a road test?
sec04-card-sec04-F33.expected_back: The rental authorization documents are not required for a leased test vehicle.

sec04-card-sec04-F34.front: May you take a Massachusetts road test on a limited-use donut spare tire?
sec04-card-sec04-F34.expected_back: A vehicle fitted with a limited-use donut spare tire cannot be used for the road test.

sec04-card-sec04-F35.front: Which three roles are the ONLY applicants allowed to use a dealer-plated passenger car for a road test?
sec04-card-sec04-F35.expected_back: A dealer-plated passenger vehicle is acceptable for a road test only when the examiner is satisfied that the applicant is the dealer, the dealer’s spouse or a dealership salesperson.

sec04-card-sec04-F36.front: What relationship proof AND vehicle-type requirement apply to a farm-plated road-test vehicle?
sec04-card-sec04-F36.expected_back: An acceptable farm-plated road-test vehicle requires proof that the applicant is the farmer’s family member or employee and must be a suitable nonpassenger vehicle, such as a pickup with a sponsor’s rear seat.

sec04-card-sec04-F37.front: Under what circumstances may a vehicle displaying a repair plate be used for a road test?
sec04-card-sec04-F37.expected_back: A vehicle displaying a repair plate cannot be used for a road test.

sec04-card-sec04-R07.front: Which three conditions let the examiner validate your paper permit as a temporary license right after passing?
sec04-card-sec04-R07.expected_back: When an applicant passes the road test, has prepaid the license and has no outstanding obligations, the examiner validates the permit as a temporary license.

sec04-card-sec04-R08.front: How long does a validated learner permit serve as a temporary license — and what cuts it shorter?
sec04-card-sec04-R08.expected_back: A validated permit used as a temporary license lasts up to sixty days unless the permit expires sooner.

sec04-card-sec04-R09.front: When must an applicant older than twenty book a service-center visit to get their license?
sec04-card-sec04-R09.expected_back: An applicant older than twenty whose filed photograph was taken before age twenty must reserve a service-center visit to obtain the license.

sec04-card-sec04-R10.front: If you pass without prepaying, how many days do you have to pay or visit — and what penalty risks hitting afterward?
sec04-card-sec04-R10.expected_back: An applicant who passes without prepaying must pay online or reserve a service-center visit within sixty days, and failure to pay in that period may require another road test at the applicant’s expense.

sec04-card-sec04-R11.front: If you pass unpaid and later pay online WITHOUT visiting a service center, do you get a temporary license?
sec04-card-sec04-R11.expected_back: Paying online after an unpaid successful road test without a service-center visit does not provide a temporary license.

sec04-card-sec04-R12.front: Which two locations satisfy Massachusetts law for carrying your valid driver license while driving?
sec04-card-sec04-R12.expected_back: A driver in Massachusetts must carry a valid license on their person or have it within easy reach inside the vehicle.

sec04-card-sec04-R13.front: What does an RMV service-center temporary receipt prove — and where does it NOT count as valid ID?
sec04-card-sec04-R13.expected_back: The service-center receipt can prove temporary driving privileges while the permanent license is produced but is not valid identification for travel.

sec04-card-sec04-R14.front: Whose information is forwarded to election officials during an RMV permit, license, or ID transaction?
sec04-card-sec04-R14.expected_back: During a permit, license or identification transaction, the information of a United States citizen legally eligible to vote is sent to the relevant election office for registration or an update.

sec04-card-sec04-R15.front: What two choices do local election officials mail you after receiving your RMV voter data?
sec04-card-sec04-R15.expected_back: Election officials mail voter information allowing the recipient to choose party enrollment or decline registration.

sec04-card-sec04-R16.front: What citizenship status and minimum age allow you to register to vote in Massachusetts?
sec04-card-sec04-R16.expected_back: Registering to vote requires United States citizenship and a minimum age of sixteen.

sec04-card-sec04-R17.front: Even though registration opens at sixteen, what minimum age is required to actually cast a vote?
sec04-card-sec04-R17.expected_back: Voting requires a minimum age of eighteen.

sec04-card-sec04-R18.front: How does a registered voter's address change travel to their town, and what confirms the update?
sec04-card-sec04-R18.expected_back: A registered voter’s address change is sent through the central voter registry to the local election office, which mails a confirmation.

sec04-card-sec04-R19.front: Which service members qualify to add the Veteran indicator to a Massachusetts license or ID?
sec04-card-sec04-R19.expected_back: An honorably discharged United States Armed Forces veteran may choose a Veteran indicator on a license or identification card.

sec04-card-sec04-R20.front: How much extra does adding the Veteran indicator cost — even if your current card isn't up for renewal yet?
sec04-card-sec04-R20.expected_back: Adding the Veteran indicator has no extra charge, and an eligible cardholder whose card is not yet renewable may obtain a free duplicate bearing it.

sec04-card-sec04-R21.front: Which three discharge forms prove eligibility for the Veteran indicator — and how must the text appear?
sec04-card-sec04-R21.expected_back: Proof for the Veteran indicator must show honorable discharge on a DD-two-hundred-fourteen, DD-two-hundred-fifteen or Honorable Discharge form, with typed rather than handwritten information.

sec04-card-sec04-R22.front: What voluntary donation choice may any Massachusetts license or ID applicant make?
sec04-card-sec04-R22.expected_back: A Massachusetts license or identification applicant may choose to register as an organ and tissue donor.

sec04-card-sec04-R23.front: What two things happen legally when you register as a donor through the RMV?
sec04-card-sec04-R23.expected_back: Registering through the RMV enters the Massachusetts Donor Registry and gives legal consent to donation.

sec04-card-sec04-R24.front: Where and when can someone join or change their Massachusetts organ-donor status?
sec04-card-sec04-R24.expected_back: A person may register or change donor status through the RMV website at any time.

sec04-card-sec04-R25.front: If you are ALREADY in the Donor Registry, what must you still mark on your renewal form to stay enrolled?
sec04-card-sec04-R25.expected_back: An already registered donor must still select yes to the donor question on the renewal form to remain in the registry.

sec04-card-sec04-R26.front: What optional dollar contribution can you add during an online renewal or duplicate order?
sec04-card-sec04-R26.expected_back: An online license or identification renewal or duplicate order may include an optional two-dollar contribution to the Organ and Tissue Donor Registration Fund.

sec04-card-sec04-R27.front: What symbol printed on a Massachusetts license or ID shows Donor Registry membership and consent?
sec04-card-sec04-R27.expected_back: A heart on the license or identification card indicates Donor Registry membership and consent for organ and tissue donation.

sec04-card-sec04-R28.front: Can someone belong to the Massachusetts Donor Registry before a heart appears on their physical card?
sec04-card-sec04-R28.expected_back: A person can join the Donor Registry online without replacing the license or identification card, so registry membership may exist before the heart is printed on a card.

sec04-card-sec04-R29.front: What does the Massachusetts Donor Registry store, and how is it checked?
sec04-card-sec04-R29.expected_back: The Massachusetts Donor Registry stores the names of people who enrolled as organ and tissue donors through the RMV and can be checked electronically.

sec04-card-sec04-R30.front: Does a driver whose license already displays the donor heart need to carry a separate donor card?
sec04-card-sec04-R30.expected_back: A driver whose license has the donor heart does not need an additional donor card.

sec04-card-sec04-R31.front: How much is a donor's family charged for organ or tissue donation?
sec04-card-sec04-R31.expected_back: The donor’s family is not charged for organ or tissue donation.

sec04-card-sec04-R32.front: How much is the Massachusetts learner-permit exam fee, and what two items does it cover?
sec04-card-sec04-R32.expected_back: The learner-permit exam fee is thirty dollars and covers application processing and exam administration.

sec04-card-sec04-R33.front: Which two events require paying a brand-new learner-permit exam fee to test again?
sec04-card-sec04-R33.expected_back: Another learner-permit exam after a failure or permit expiration requires another exam fee.

sec04-card-sec04-R34.front: What is the dollar fee for a Massachusetts road test?
sec04-card-sec04-R34.expected_back: The road-test fee is thirty-five dollars.

sec04-card-sec04-R35.front: Which four unsuccessful road-test outcomes still owe the thirty-five-dollar fee before you can book again?
sec04-card-sec04-R35.expected_back: A failed, missed or examiner-rejected road test, or a cancellation with less than seventy-two hours of notice, still incurs the road-test fee, which must be paid before booking a new test.

sec04-card-sec04-R36.front: How much does issuing or renewing a standard five-year Massachusetts Class D license cost?
sec04-card-sec04-R36.expected_back: Issuing or renewing a Class D license costs fifty dollars.

sec04-card-sec04-R37.front: How is the fee calculated when a license is issued for less than five years?
sec04-card-sec04-R37.expected_back: The fee for a license issued for less than five years is prorated to its term.

sec04-card-sec04-R38.front: How much does ordering a duplicate or amended Massachusetts license cost?
sec04-card-sec04-R38.expected_back: A duplicate or amended license costs twenty-five dollars.

sec04-card-sec04-R39.front: Are Massachusetts license fees refundable, and are printed manual amounts locked permanently?
sec04-card-sec04-R39.expected_back: License fees are not refundable and all listed fees may change.

sec04-card-sec04-R40.front: Which veterans pay zero Massachusetts driver-license transaction fees?
sec04-card-sec04-R40.expected_back: A disabled veteran with Disabled Veteran plates, or who qualified for those plates through Medical Affairs, pays no driver-license transaction fees.

sec05-card-sec05-F01.front: Beyond protecting the driver, which two groups benefit directly from safe driving habits?
sec05-card-sec05-F01.expected_back: Safe driving behavior protects passengers and other road users as well as the driver.

sec05-card-sec05-F02.front: Which two ongoing vehicle-care practices does the Massachusetts manual tie directly to driving safety?
sec05-card-sec05-F02.expected_back: Regular inspections and proper vehicle maintenance are important for driving safety.

sec05-card-sec05-F03.front: What safety-belt equipment standard must every passenger vehicle meet for everyone aboard?
sec05-card-sec05-F03.expected_back: A passenger vehicle needs an undamaged, working safety belt for its driver and every passenger.

sec05-card-sec05-F04.front: Which five non-lighting components — covering visibility, sound, security, rain, and exhaust — must passenger cars carry?
sec05-card-sec05-F04.expected_back: Passenger vehicles must have mirrors, a horn, an ignition lock, windshield wipers and an exhaust muffler.

sec05-card-sec05-F05.front: Which two separate braking systems must every passenger vehicle have?
