sec14-card-sec14-F33.front: Is parking on the left side of a two-way street facing oncoming traffic allowed?
sec14-card-sec14-F33.expected_back: Do not park facing against traffic.

sec14-card-sec14-F34.front: When is non-emergency parking permitted along a state or interstate highway?
sec14-card-sec14-F34.expected_back: Do not park on a state or interstate highway unless authorized.

sec14-card-sec14-F35.front: What fine range applies to unauthorized parking along the Massachusetts Turnpike?
sec14-card-sec14-F35.expected_back: Parking on the Massachusetts Turnpike can bring a fine from fifteen to one hundred dollars.

sec14-card-sec14-F36.front: Where outside town centers is using the roadway itself as a parking spot prohibited?
sec14-card-sec14-F36.memory_hook: No roadway parking in rural areas
sec14-card-sec14-F36.expected_back: A roadway cannot serve as a parking place when it lies in a rural area or is outside a thickly settled district.

sec14-card-sec14-F37.front: What does Massachusetts law say about double parking alongside cars already parked at the curb?
sec14-card-sec14-F37.expected_back: Double parking beside a line of parked vehicles is prohibited.

sec14-card-sec14-F38.front: May you park on a public street to carry out routine nonemergency vehicle repairs?
sec14-card-sec14-F38.expected_back: Parking to perform nonemergency vehicle repairs is prohibited.

sec14-card-sec14-F39.front: Who sets most parking-ticket amounts, and what RMV consequence follows unpaid parking tickets?
sec14-card-sec14-F39.expected_back: Most parking fines vary by municipality, and unpaid tickets can prevent license or registration renewal.

sec14-card-sec14-F40.front: What two meter mistakes can earn you a parking citation?
sec14-card-sec14-F40.expected_back: Failure to pay a parking meter or exceeding the posted time can lead to a citation.

sec14-card-sec14-F41.front: What two credentials allow parking on a street marked for resident permits only?
sec14-card-sec14-F41.expected_back: A resident-permit-only street requires a resident permit or authorized visitor placard.

sec14-card-sec14-F47.front: How should pedestrians use marked crosswalks and push-button walk signals?
sec14-card-sec14-F47.expected_back: Use an available crosswalk and wait for WALK at a signaled crossing, using the request button when one is provided.

sec14-card-sec14-F48.front: What curb stop and three-step look pattern should pedestrians use, even at a one-way street?
sec14-card-sec14-F48.expected_back: Before crossing, stop at the curb and look left, right and left again even on a one-way road.

sec14-card-sec14-F49.front: Where should a pedestrian pause and check when emerging from between parked vehicles?
sec14-card-sec14-F49.expected_back: When stepping out between parked vehicles, stop and look before crossing.

sec14-card-sec14-F50.front: Where must a pedestrian walk when no sidewalk is available along a road?
sec14-card-sec14-F50.expected_back: Use an available sidewalk, or otherwise walk on the shoulder facing traffic.

sec14-card-sec14-F51.front: On which three high-speed highway types is walking along or across strictly forbidden?
sec14-card-sec14-F51.expected_back: Never walk on or across an expressway, interstate highway or turnpike.

sec14-card-sec14-F52.front: What clothing choices help drivers spot pedestrians, especially after dark?
sec14-card-sec14-F52.expected_back: Bright clothing or reflective strips improve pedestrian visibility, especially after dark.

sec14-card-sec14-F53.front: May bicyclists use the full travel lane even when a bike lane exists, and where are bikes barred?
sec14-card-sec14-F53.memory_hook: Full lane allowed except posted expressways
sec14-card-sec14-F53.expected_back: Bicyclists may use the full lane even when a bicycle lane exists, except on a limited-access or express state highway with signs prohibiting bicycles.

sec14-card-sec14-R01.front: In what direction must bicyclists ride, and how must they treat red lights and stop signs?
sec14-card-sec14-R01.expected_back: Ride a bicycle with traffic unless signs or markings provide otherwise, and stop at red lights and stop signs.

sec14-card-sec14-R02.front: On which side may a bicyclist legally overtake a motor vehicle in the same lane?
sec14-card-sec14-R02.expected_back: A bicyclist may keep right while passing a motor vehicle traveling in the lane.

sec14-card-sec14-R03.front: Which hand may a Massachusetts cyclist use to signal, and when may a signal be skipped?
sec14-card-sec14-R03.expected_back: A bicyclist signals a turn or stop with either hand but may omit or interrupt the signal when both hands are needed for safe operation.

sec14-card-sec14-R04.front: Where may a bicyclist legally ride on a sidewalk in Massachusetts?
sec14-card-sec14-R04.expected_back: A bicyclist may use a sidewalk outside a business district for safety unless local law prohibits it.

sec14-card-sec14-R05.front: What yielding and sound rules apply to cyclists passing pedestrians on sidewalks or shared paths?
sec14-card-sec14-R05.expected_back: On a sidewalk or shared path, bicyclists must yield to pedestrians and give an audible warning before passing without using a siren or whistle.

sec14-card-sec14-R06.front: How many cyclists may ride side by side, and what rule applies on multilane same-direction roads?
sec14-card-sec14-R06.memory_hook: Max two abreast inside one lane
sec14-card-sec14-R06.expected_back: No more than two bicycles may travel side by side, and on a multilane same-direction road they must remain in one lane without unnecessarily preventing a pass.

sec14-card-sec14-R07.front: How should bicyclists manage spacing from other riders and speed near busy crosswalks?
sec14-card-sec14-R07.expected_back: Keep a safe distance from other bicycles and slow near crosswalks, especially during heavy traffic.

sec14-card-sec14-R08.front: What seating equipment must every bicycle rider and passenger use?
sec14-card-sec14-R08.expected_back: A bicycle operator and passenger must use permanent seats attached to the bicycle or an allowed towed trailer.

sec14-card-sec14-R09.front: Which young children require an upright harnessed baby bike seat with spoke protection?
sec14-card-sec14-R09.expected_back: A passenger from one through four years old or weighing forty pounds or less needs an attached baby seat with an upright harnessed position and protection from wheel spokes.

sec14-card-sec14-R10.front: What physical fit requirement lets a passenger ride on a tandem bicycle seat?
sec14-card-sec14-R10.expected_back: A tandem passenger may use the tandem seat when able to reach the pedals and handlebars.

sec14-card-sec14-R11.front: At what young age is a child completely barred from being carried on a bicycle?
sec14-card-sec14-R11.expected_back: A child younger than one year may not be transported on a bicycle.

sec14-card-sec14-R12.front: Under what age must bicycle riders and passengers wear a secured approved helmet, and what is the exception?
sec14-card-sec14-R12.expected_back: A bicycle rider or passenger younger than sixteen must use a secured Consumer Product Safety Commission-approved helmet on a public road or bicycle path unless a passenger’s enclosed trailer protects the head.

sec14-card-sec14-R13.front: What condition governs parking a bicycle on a road or sidewalk?
sec14-card-sec14-R13.expected_back: A bicycle may be parked on a road or sidewalk only without obstructing vehicle or pedestrian travel.

sec14-card-sec14-R14.front: May a bicycle be pulled by another vehicle, and what is the only thing a bicycle may tow?
sec14-card-sec14-R14.expected_back: A bicycle must not be pulled by another vehicle and may tow only a bicycle trailer.

sec14-card-sec14-R15.front: What hand and cargo rule must every bicyclist follow while riding?
sec14-card-sec14-R15.expected_back: A bicyclist must keep at least one hand on the handlebars and not carry items that prevent safe operation.

sec14-card-sec14-R16.front: Within how many feet must bicycle brakes be able to stop from fifteen miles per hour?
sec14-card-sec14-R16.expected_back: Bicycle brakes must be capable of stopping from fifteen miles per hour within thirty feet.

sec14-card-sec14-R17.front: Half an hour past sunset until half an hour before sunrise, what bike lights are required?
sec14-card-sec14-R17.expected_back: From thirty minutes after sunset to thirty minutes before sunrise, a bicycle needs a front white light visible to five hundred feet and a rear red light or reflector visible to six hundred feet.

sec14-card-sec14-R18.front: What side and pedal reflector visibility is required on a bicycle during nighttime hours?
sec14-card-sec14-R18.expected_back: During the stated nighttime period, pedal or ankle reflectors or other reflective material must be visible from six hundred feet on every side.

sec14-card-sec14-R19.front: What height and design limits apply to bicycle handlebars and front forks?
sec14-card-sec14-R19.expected_back: Bicycle handlebars cannot be higher than the rider’s shoulders when gripped, and the fork cannot be extended beyond the original manufacturer design.

sec14-card-sec14-R20.front: When must a bicyclist report a crash to local police, and what dollar threshold triggers it?
sec14-card-sec14-R20.expected_back: A bicyclist must report an injury crash or a crash with property damage above one hundred dollars to the police where it occurred.

sec14-card-sec14-R21.front: How should a cyclist ride in lanes and adjust speed when legally sharing a sidewalk?
sec14-card-sec14-R21.expected_back: Ride a bicycle in a straight line at a suitable speed, using walking speed and yielding to pedestrians on a sidewalk where riding is allowed.

sec14-card-sec14-R22.front: How should bicyclists treat cell phones and texting while riding?
sec14-card-sec14-R22.expected_back: Put the phone away while bicycling and do not text while riding.

sec14-card-sec14-R23.front: At least how far from parked cars should a bicyclist ride to clear opening doors?
sec14-card-sec14-R23.expected_back: Ride at least three feet away from parked cars to stay outside the opening-door area.

sec14-card-sec14-R24.front: On which side should you pass other bicycles, and how should you queue at red lights?
sec14-card-sec14-R24.expected_back: Pass other bicycles on the left with room and do not cut in ahead of riders stopped at an intersection.

sec14-card-sec14-R25.front: How should bicyclists approach intersections rather than racing past turning drivers?
sec14-card-sec14-R25.expected_back: At intersections, bicyclists should slow, seek eye contact and anticipate turns instead of racing past a driver.

sec14-card-sec14-R26.front: What three rules keep bicyclists safe around tractor-trailers and heavy trucks?
sec14-card-sec14-R26.memory_hook: Give room, blind spots, never right
sec14-card-sec14-R26.expected_back: Bicyclists should give large vehicles room, avoid their blind spots and never pass a moving tractor-trailer on the right.

sec14-card-sec14-R27.front: How should a bicyclist handle passing a transit bus on the right versus on the left?
sec14-card-sec14-R27.expected_back: Do not pass a bus on the right, and when passing left expect the bus to reenter traffic.

sec14-card-sec14-R28.front: What headphone or earbud rule applies to bicyclists on the road?
sec14-card-sec14-R28.expected_back: A bicyclist should not wear headphones or earbuds in both ears.

sec14-card-sec14-R29.front: After overtaking a bicyclist, when may a motorist move back toward the right?
sec14-card-sec14-R29.expected_back: After passing a bicycle on the right side of your vehicle, do not return right until safely clear of the rider.

sec14-card-sec14-R30.front: What must a driver do before turning right after passing a bicyclist?
sec14-card-sec14-R30.expected_back: Before turning right after passing a bicycle, allow safe distance from the rider and use a reasonable proper turning speed.

sec14-card-sec14-R31.front: What must a driver do in a narrow lane behind a bike, and what minimum passing gap applies?
sec14-card-sec14-R31.expected_back: If a lane is too narrow to pass a bicycle safely, wait for room in an adjacent lane or a safe passing opportunity and keep at least four feet clear.

sec14-card-sec14-R32.front: When must a left-turning driver yield to an oncoming bicyclist?
sec14-card-sec14-R32.expected_back: A driver turning left must yield to an opposing bicycle already in the intersection or close enough to create an immediate hazard.

sec14-card-sec14-R33.front: Does a cyclist's legal position to the right of motor traffic excuse a driver who hits them?
sec14-card-sec14-R33.expected_back: A bicycle may legally be to the right of motor traffic, and that position does not excuse a driver who causes a collision with it.

sec14-card-sec14-R34.front: Up to how much can a driver or passenger be fined for opening a vehicle door into a cyclist?
sec14-card-sec14-R34.expected_back: A driver or passenger can be fined up to one hundred dollars for opening a door into an approaching bicycle.

sec14-card-sec14-R35.front: What simple check must every occupant make before opening a vehicle door?
sec14-card-sec14-R35.expected_back: Before opening a vehicle door, look behind for an approaching bicyclist.

sec14-card-sec14-R44.front: How does a separated bicycle lane divide traffic, and what color markings may cross intersections?
sec14-card-sec14-R44.expected_back: A separated bicycle lane physically divides bicycle traffic from motor traffic and may use green bicycle markings across an intersection.

sec14-card-sec14-R45.front: Where must pedestrians walk when a separated bicycle lane runs alongside a sidewalk?
sec14-card-sec14-R45.expected_back: Pedestrians must stay on the sidewalk rather than in a bicycle lane.

sec14-card-sec14-R46.front: What stop and yield duties apply to drivers turning right across a protected bicycle lane?
sec14-card-sec14-R46.expected_back: At a protected-lane intersection, drivers must stop at the stop line and yield to crossing pedestrians and bicycles before turning right.

sec14-card-sec14-R47.front: Where must you look before turning across any bicycle lane?
sec14-card-sec14-R47.expected_back: Before turning across a bicycle lane, check for approaching bicycles, including looking beside and behind the vehicle when needed.

sec14-card-sec14-R48.front: What three rules apply to bicyclists riding through a protected-lane intersection?
sec14-card-sec14-R48.memory_hook: Right direction, watch turns, yield walkers
sec14-card-sec14-R48.expected_back: Bicyclists must use the proper lane direction, continue through the intersection in the lane while watching for turns and yield to crossing pedestrians.

sec14-card-sec14-R49.front: What three visual or judgment traps must motorists guard against around bicycles?
sec14-card-sec14-R49.memory_hook: Hidden riders, fast speed, wide space
sec14-card-sec14-R49.expected_back: Drivers must watch for bicycles hidden by vehicles or buildings and avoid underestimating a bicycle’s speed or the space needed to pass it.

sec14-card-sec14-R36.front: What mirror checks and hand choice make up the Dutch Reach when opening a car door?
sec14-card-sec14-R36.memory_hook: Both mirrors, open with far hand
sec14-card-sec14-R36.expected_back: Before opening a door, check the inside mirror and side mirror, then use the hand farther from the door to open it.

sec14-card-sec14-R37.front: What two safety benefits come from opening your car door with the hand farther from it?
sec14-card-sec14-R37.expected_back: Opening with the far hand turns the body to improve the view of approaching cyclists and slows the door’s opening.

sec14-card-sec14-R38.front: Does riding inside a painted bicycle lane remove the need to stay three feet from parked cars?
sec14-card-sec14-R38.memory_hook: Keep three feet even in lanes
sec14-card-sec14-R38.expected_back: Keep at least three feet from parked cars when bicycling whether or not a bicycle lane is present.

sec14-card-sec14-R39.front: What is a bicycle box, where does it sit, and how does it help riders at red lights?
sec14-card-sec14-R39.expected_back: A bicycle box is a green bicycle-marked area before the crosswalk that spans the travel lane and helps riders position for a turn at red.

sec14-card-sec14-R40.front: Where must motorists stop at a red light that has an empty green bicycle box?
sec14-card-sec14-R40.expected_back: Drivers must stop behind a bicycle box even when empty and wait for green.

sec14-card-sec14-R41.front: How should a bicyclist use a bicycle box to set up a left turn at a red light?
sec14-card-sec14-R41.expected_back: A bicyclist making a left turn from the box should move to its left side, signal and wait for green.

sec14-card-sec14-R42.front: Where and how should cyclists wait inside a bicycle box when going straight or turning right?
sec14-card-sec14-R42.expected_back: Bicyclists going straight or right should wait on the box’s right side in a staggered arrangement for green.

sec14-card-sec14-R43.front: What two green-light crossings make up a two-stage bicycle left turn?
sec14-card-sec14-R43.memory_hook: Cross straight to cross-road box, wait
sec14-card-sec14-R43.expected_back: For a two-stage bicycle left turn, first cross straight on green into the destination road’s bicycle box, then wait for that road’s green before crossing straight again.

sec14-card-sec14-R50.front: Who is at fault in the manual's Left Cross bicycle crash scenario, and what must drivers watch for?
sec14-card-sec14-R50.expected_back: Left Cross is one of the manual's common motor-vehicle-and-bicycle crash scenarios in which the motorist is at fault and must watch for bicycles hidden by buildings or other vehicles.

sec14-card-sec14-R51.front: Who is at fault in the manual's Right Hook bicycle crash scenario, and what mistake causes it?
sec14-card-sec14-R51.expected_back: Right Hook is one of the manual's common motor-vehicle-and-bicycle crash scenarios in which the motorist is at fault and must not misjudge a bicyclist's speed.

sec14-card-sec14-R52.front: Who is at fault in a Drive Out bicycle crash, and how can cyclists make themselves more visible?
sec14-card-sec14-R52.expected_back: Drive Out is one of the manual's common motor-vehicle-and-bicycle crash scenarios in which the motorist is at fault, while bicyclists can improve visibility by riding farther left in the lane.

sec14-card-sec14-R53.front: Who is at fault in a Sideswipe bicycle crash, and what passing error must drivers avoid?
sec14-card-sec14-R53.memory_hook: Motorist fault, give full passing room
sec14-card-sec14-R53.expected_back: Sideswipe is one of the manual's common motor-vehicle-and-bicycle crash scenarios in which the motorist is at fault and must not underestimate the passing space a bicyclist needs.

sec01-card-sec01-F01.question_text: What credential is required before operating a vehicle on Massachusetts streets or public-access ways?
sec01-card-sec01-F01.teaching_text: Parking lots and access roads open to the public still count, so driving unlicensed there invites citations.

sec01-card-sec01-F02.question_text: Which Massachusetts license class covers passenger vehicles, vans, and small trucks?
sec01-card-sec01-F02.teaching_text: Picking a commercial or motorcycle class by mistake trips up applicants looking for standard everyday driving privileges.

sec01-card-sec01-F03.question_text: Who may reserve an RMV visit to begin the Class D licensing process?
sec01-card-sec01-F03.teaching_text: Booking an appointment fails fast if you live out of state, are fifteen, or carry an active revocation.

sec01-card-sec01-F04.question_text: Other than a Liquor ID card, who is eligible to receive a Massachusetts license or ID card?
sec01-card-sec01-F04.teaching_text: The Liquor ID is the lone non-resident exception, while every driver license and state ID demands state residency.

sec01-card-sec01-F05.question_text: Does owning property or staying temporarily in Massachusetts qualify a non-resident for a driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-F05.teaching_text: Summer homes and short stays leave your legal domicile elsewhere, so the RMV will turn down your application.

sec01-card-sec01-F06.question_text: Can someone under sixteen drive in Massachusetts using a valid permit or license from another state?
sec01-card-sec01-F06.teaching_text: Even when a home state licenses fifteen-year-olds, crossing the Massachusetts border behind the wheel is strictly illegal.

sec01-card-sec01-F07.question_text: What minimum age must an applicant reach before applying for a Class D learner permit?
sec01-card-sec01-F07.teaching_text: Showing up even one day before your sixteenth birthday means the RMV cannot accept your permit paperwork.

sec01-card-sec01-F08.question_text: What three conditions must a teen meet for the early Class D license path at sixteen and a half?
sec01-card-sec01-F08.teaching_text: Missing driver education or breaking your six-month clean-permit streak delays your road-skills eligibility right away.

sec01-card-sec01-F09.question_text: Where does Massachusetts require individuals convicted of sex offenses to register?
sec01-card-sec01-F09.teaching_text: State law ties community safety compliance directly to registering in person with police in your home locality.

sec01-card-sec01-F10.question_text: Under what age is written permission required when applying for a permit, license, or state ID?
sec01-card-sec01-F10.teaching_text: Walking into the service center under eighteen without signed permission stops your application at the counter.

sec01-card-sec01-F11.question_text: Which four adult roles are authorized to give written consent for an applicant under eighteen?
sec01-card-sec01-F11.teaching_text: Older siblings or relatives without legal authority cannot sign, so bring consent from one of those four roles.

sec01-card-sec01-F12.question_text: Where does the consenting adult sign on a minor's permit or identification application?
sec01-card-sec01-F12.teaching_text: Leaving the reverse side blank forces a return trip because clerks verify the consent signature there.

sec01-card-sec01-F13.question_text: When someone other than a parent signs for a minor, when must proof of guardian status be shown?
sec01-card-sec01-F13.teaching_text: Bringing guardianship papers only for the permit is a classic trap because you need them again later.

sec01-card-sec01-F14.question_text: What can happen to your license if an application signature is falsified?
sec01-card-sec01-F14.teaching_text: Forging parent consent leaves a permanent fraud trail that lets the RMV pull your driving privilege.

sec01-card-sec01-F15.question_text: Which five RMV credentials require capturing a photograph of every applicant?
sec01-card-sec01-F15.teaching_text: Even non-driving cards like disability placards and Liquor IDs require an RMV camera image on file.

sec01-card-sec01-F16.question_text: How must an applicant face and appear in the required RMV photograph?
sec01-card-sec01-F16.teaching_text: Angled poses or hair hiding your eyes fail identity verification standards used by law enforcement.

sec01-card-sec01-F17.question_text: Are solid or transparent coverings over the face allowed in an RMV photograph?
sec01-card-sec01-F17.teaching_text: Clear shields still create glare and distortion, so any face covering is rejected at the camera station.

sec01-card-sec01-F18.question_text: May you wear prescription or reading glasses when taking your RMV photograph?
sec01-card-sec01-F18.teaching_text: Frames and lens glare block biometric eye matching, even when you wear prescription glasses every single day.

sec01-card-sec01-F19.question_text: Under what reasons and visibility condition may a head covering be worn in an RMV photo?
sec01-card-sec01-F19.teaching_text: Fashion hats must come off, and approved religious or medical headwear still cannot shadow any facial feature.

sec01-card-sec01-F20.question_text: When are facial hair and hairpieces rejected in an RMV photograph?
sec01-card-sec01-F20.teaching_text: Everyday beards and wigs are fine, provided they never hide facial landmarks or mask how you look.

sec01-card-sec01-F21.question_text: How does RMV photo policy treat permanent facial tattoos compared with temporary ones?
sec01-card-sec01-F21.teaching_text: Wash-off stickers alter your look for a day, whereas permanent ink is part of your lasting identity.

sec01-card-sec01-F22.question_text: Are Bluetooth headsets allowed to stay on during your RMV photograph?
sec01-card-sec01-F22.teaching_text: Leaving wireless earpieces clipped on blocks part of your ear and face, forcing a retake.

sec01-card-sec01-F23.question_text: Who conducts a vision screen during a learner-permit or driver-license application?
sec01-card-sec01-F23.teaching_text: Expect the eye check right at the service counter before your permit or license paperwork wraps up.

sec01-card-sec01-F24.question_text: What three visual abilities does the RMV vision screen evaluate?
sec01-card-sec01-F24.teaching_text: Safe driving relies on reading distant signs, telling signal colors apart, and spotting hazards from the sides.

sec01-card-sec01-F25.question_text: What must applicants do for the vision screen if they normally wear contacts or glasses for distance?
sec01-card-sec01-F25.teaching_text: Forgetting your glasses or contacts at home can make you fail an eye screen you would easily pass.

sec01-card-sec01-F26.question_text: What minimum acuity and horizontal peripheral vision are required for an unrestricted full Class D license?
sec01-card-sec01-F26.teaching_text: Know both numbers cold because knowledge questions love pairing twenty-over-forty sharpness with that side-vision angle.

sec01-card-sec01-F27.question_text: What corrected acuity range in the better eye may qualify an applicant for a daylight-only license?
sec01-card-sec01-F27.teaching_text: Drivers in this middle acuity band can still drive safely before dusk when glare and low contrast vanish.

sec01-card-sec01-F28.question_text: What paperwork may replace the counter vision screen when someone cannot take, declines, or fails it?
sec01-card-sec01-F28.teaching_text: Photocopies will not pass muster, so bring the original signed form from an optometrist or ophthalmologist.

sec01-card-sec01-F29.question_text: Where can an applicant get a blank Vision Screening Certificate?
sec01-card-sec01-F29.teaching_text: Grabbing the form online before your eye appointment saves an extra trip back to the doctor's office.

sec01-card-sec01-F30.question_text: What prior licensing history must you list on permit applications, license applications, and renewals?
sec01-card-sec01-F30.teaching_text: Leaving off an old state license delays processing once national databases surface your past record.
sec01-card-sec01-F30.must_match_memory_hook: Every state and number, ten years

visual_sync.text_span: Every state and number, ten years

sec01-card-sec01-F31.question_text: Which nationwide system does the RMV check for suspensions and revocations across all fifty states?
sec01-card-sec01-F31.teaching_text: Moving to Massachusetts never wipes a suspended record because all fifty states share pointer alerts.

sec01-card-sec01-F32.question_text: What happens if your application triggers a match in the Problem Driver Pointer System?
sec01-card-sec01-F32.teaching_text: Massachusetts freezes your application until the reporting state confirms every suspension or conviction is resolved.

sec01-card-sec01-F33.question_text: May a driver legally hold valid driver licenses from more than one state at the same time?
sec01-card-sec01-F33.teaching_text: Keeping a backup license from your old state violates interstate driver rules the moment you switch.

sec01-card-sec01-R01.question_text: What happens to a prior participating state's license or ID when Massachusetts issues a non-Liquor card?
sec01-card-sec01-R01.teaching_text: Participating states sync electronically, automatically voiding your previous card except when getting a Liquor ID.

sec01-card-sec01-R02.question_text: Between which two card types does a Massachusetts applicant choose?
sec01-card-sec01-R02.teaching_text: Deciding upfront matters because document checklists differ sharply between federal-compliant and Standard cards.

sec01-card-sec01-R03.question_text: How does the fee for a Massachusetts REAL ID compare with the fee for a Standard card?
sec01-card-sec01-R03.teaching_text: Many applicants assume federal compliance costs extra, when the RMV charges the exact same price.

sec01-card-sec01-R04.question_text: What identification do you need for domestic flights or entry into certain federal buildings?
sec01-card-sec01-R04.teaching_text: Showing up at airport security with only a non-compliant card can keep you from boarding.

sec01-card-sec01-R05.question_text: Which federal law does a Massachusetts REAL ID satisfy, and what two access uses does it cover?
sec01-card-sec01-R05.teaching_text: Carrying that compliant card lets you breeze through domestic TSA checkpoints and restricted federal entrances.

sec01-card-sec01-R06.question_text: Do Standard and REAL ID Massachusetts driver licenses grant different driving privileges?
sec01-card-sec01-R06.teaching_text: Behind the wheel on public roads, police treat Standard and compliant driver licenses identically.

sec01-card-sec01-R07.question_text: Can a Standard Massachusetts card by itself be used for domestic flights and covered federal facilities?
sec01-card-sec01-R07.teaching_text: A Standard card works great for driving, yet federal checkpoints reject it as standalone travel identification.

sec01-card-sec01-R08.question_text: What must a Standard Massachusetts cardholder bring to board domestic flights or enter covered federal buildings?
sec01-card-sec01-R08.teaching_text: Keeping an unexpired passport handy lets Standard license holders fly domestically without switching card types.

sec01-card-sec01-R09.question_text: Which licensing requirements stay identical between Standard and compliant cards, and which requirements differ?
sec01-card-sec01-R09.teaching_text: Age, fitness, and driving evaluations never change between the two options, only the identity paperwork you bring.

sec01-card-sec01-R10.question_text: How many driver licenses or identification cards may a person hold at one time?
sec01-card-sec01-R10.teaching_text: You cannot carry both a state ID card and a driver license simultaneously in your wallet.

sec01-card-sec01-R11.question_text: What four personal facts does an RMV driver license serve as primary identification to prove?
sec01-card-sec01-R11.teaching_text: Banks, clerks, and officers rely on those four verified data points printed directly on your license.

sec01-card-sec01-R12.question_text: Which two biometric or personal items from a cardholder does the RMV store in its central computer?
sec01-card-sec01-R12.teaching_text: Digital storage lets the RMV verify renewals and catch identity fraud across future transactions.

sec01-card-sec01-R13.question_text: How is Class D defined relative to Classes A, B, C, and M, and what vehicles are typical?
sec01-card-sec01-R13.teaching_text: Anything that is not a heavy commercial rig or motorcycle usually lands inside everyday Class D driving.

sec01-card-sec01-R14.question_text: What is the maximum duration of a Massachusetts driver license, and on what day does it usually expire?
sec01-card-sec01-R14.teaching_text: Checking your birthday year keeps you from accidentally driving past expiration after five years.

sec01-card-sec01-R15.question_text: When can a Massachusetts REAL ID license or ID card be issued for fewer than five years?
sec01-card-sec01-R15.teaching_text: Federal rules tie card validity directly to how long your immigration documents authorize your stay.

sec01-card-sec01-R16.question_text: What minimum lawful-presence period is required for REAL ID, even if less time currently remains?
sec01-card-sec01-R16.teaching_text: Documents originally granting at least a year of authorized stay can qualify even later in that window.

sec01-card-sec01-R17.question_text: How do the fee and expiration date work when a REAL ID is issued for fewer than five years?
sec01-card-sec01-R17.teaching_text: You pay only for the shorter span, and the card expires when your authorized stay ends.

sec01-card-sec01-R18.question_text: How many years is a Standard Massachusetts driver license valid?
sec01-card-sec01-R18.teaching_text: Standard licenses follow a predictable five-year renewal cycle regardless of federal travel choices.

sec01-card-sec01-R19.question_text: How early before expiration can you renew a Massachusetts license or identification card?
sec01-card-sec01-R19.teaching_text: Renewing months ahead beats scrambling for appointments right before your birthday deadline.

sec01-card-sec01-R20.question_text: What card orientation and marking do you receive if issued or renewed before turning twenty-one?
sec01-card-sec01-R20.teaching_text: Vertical orientation gives clerks and officers an instant visual cue that the holder was under twenty-one.

sec01-card-sec01-R21.question_text: Does a vertical license or ID card become invalid once the holder turns twenty-one?
sec01-card-sec01-R21.teaching_text: You do not have to rush to the RMV on your birthday because the card works until expiration.

sec01-card-sec01-R22.question_text: When can a cardholder obtain a horizontal Massachusetts driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-R22.teaching_text: Applying before your twenty-first birthday still prints vertically, so hold off if you want horizontal.

sec01-card-sec01-R23.question_text: What do license restrictions do, and where do their letter codes appear on the card?
sec01-card-sec01-R23.teaching_text: Officers check both sides of your card during a traffic stop to verify you follow every condition.

sec01-card-sec01-R24.question_text: What driving limitation does Massachusetts license restriction code A impose?
sec01-card-sec01-R24.teaching_text: Driving solo or with friends violates this restriction because a certified driving instructor must accompany you.

sec01-card-sec01-R25.question_text: What equipment must a driver use when license restriction code B appears on the card?
sec01-card-sec01-R25.teaching_text: Code B is the classic vision restriction, meaning driving without your glasses or contacts breaks your license terms.

sec01-card-sec01-R26.question_text: What requirement does Massachusetts license restriction code C identify?
sec01-card-sec01-R26.teaching_text: Don't mix up C and D on quizzes, since C points to vehicle mechanical aids like hand controls.

sec01-card-sec01-R27.question_text: What type of aid does Massachusetts license restriction code D identify?
sec01-card-sec01-R27.teaching_text: While code C covers vehicle equipment, code D covers a prosthetic or personal medical aid worn by you.

sec01-card-sec01-R28.question_text: When may a holder drive if Massachusetts restriction code G is on the license?
sec01-card-sec01-R28.teaching_text: Drivers meeting reduced vision standards often carry code G so they stay off dark nighttime roads.

sec01-card-sec01-R29.question_text: To what purpose does Massachusetts license restriction code H limit driving?
sec01-card-sec01-R29.teaching_text: Personal errands and social trips stay off-limits when your license restricts operation strictly to job duties.

sec01-card-sec01-R30.question_text: What does Massachusetts license restriction code I denote?
sec01-card-sec01-R30.teaching_text: Teens under eighteen spot code I on their card flagging passenger, night, and Junior Operator limits.

sec01-card-sec01-R31.question_text: What does Massachusetts license restriction code J indicate on a driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-R31.teaching_text: Code J acts as a catch-all flag alerting officers to check custom conditions tied to your driving record.

sec01-card-sec01-R32.question_text: How does restriction code Q limit a Massachusetts Class D driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-R32.teaching_text: With code Q on your Class D card, hopping into a manual stick-shift car violates your license.

sec01-card-sec01-R33.question_text: What health-monitoring requirement does Massachusetts restriction code two identify?
sec01-card-sec01-R33.teaching_text: Keeping blood-sugar checks documented protects against sudden hypoglycemia episodes while behind the wheel.

sec02-card-sec02-F01.question_text: What specialized vision device does Massachusetts license restriction code R identify?
sec02-card-sec02-F01.teaching_text: Drivers using specialized telescopic eyewear carry code R so officers know that vision equipment is required.

sec02-card-sec02-F02.question_text: What health proof must a driver carry when restriction code S is on the license?
sec02-card-sec02-F02.teaching_text: Verifying safe glucose levels before driving helps prevent dangerous low-blood-sugar blackouts in traffic.

sec02-card-sec02-F03.question_text: What vehicle safety device does Massachusetts license restriction code T require?
sec02-card-sec02-F03.teaching_text: Operating any car without an installed breath-check interlock device violates code T and triggers harsh penalties.

sec02-card-sec02-F04.question_text: What medical status does Massachusetts license restriction code V identify?
sec02-card-sec02-F04.teaching_text: Know the V-versus-W split, because V flags an approved medical variance rather than an intrastate waiver.

sec02-card-sec02-F05.question_text: What medical authorization does Massachusetts license restriction code W identify?
sec02-card-sec02-F05.teaching_text: Intrastate means inside Massachusetts borders, separating code W waivers from code V variances on license checks.

sec02-card-sec02-F06.question_text: Which RMV unit evaluates physical or mental conditions affecting driving and places license restrictions?
sec02-card-sec02-F06.teaching_text: Any physical or mental change impacting vehicle control goes through specialized RMV medical review for tailored limits.

sec02-card-sec02-F07.question_text: What restriction and driving rule apply when you pass the vision check wearing glasses or contacts?
sec02-card-sec02-F07.teaching_text: Passing your eye check with glasses locks code B onto your card, making bare-eye driving illegal.

sec02-card-sec02-F08.question_text: Who assigns license restrictions when a driver needs a mechanical aid or prosthetic device to drive?
sec02-card-sec02-F08.teaching_text: Specialized adaptive controls and prosthetics get matched to the right license codes by RMV medical staff.

sec02-card-sec02-F09.question_text: How does Medical Affairs evaluate applications, and what document might they request from your doctor?
sec02-card-sec02-F09.teaching_text: No two health profiles are identical, so a doctor's clearance note often guides safe equipment decisions.

sec02-card-sec02-F10.question_text: Which restriction code is automatically added to the license of every driver under eighteen?
sec02-card-sec02-F10.teaching_text: Every teen license carries code I until eighteen so officers immediately recognize Junior Operator rules apply.

sec02-card-sec02-F11.question_text: What licensed driver age span defines a Massachusetts Junior Operator?
sec02-card-sec02-F11.teaching_text: Once you pass your road test before eighteen, Junior Operator curfews and passenger limits govern every drive.

sec02-card-sec02-F12.question_text: How long must a Junior Operator applicant hold a valid learner permit before taking the road test?
sec02-card-sec02-F12.teaching_text: Rushing into a road test early is blocked because six unbroken months build multi-season road judgment.

sec02-card-sec02-F13.question_text: What happens to a Junior Operator applicant's six-month permit clock if the permit is suspended?
sec02-card-sec02-F13.teaching_text: Prior months never carry over after a permit suspension, forcing you to restart day one upon reinstatement.

sec02-card-sec02-F14.question_text: How long must a Junior Operator applicant maintain a clean driving record before the road test?
sec02-card-sec02-F14.teaching_text: Even a single citation during your permit stretch restarts your wait for road-test eligibility.

sec02-card-sec02-F15.question_text: How many classroom, behind-the-wheel, and observation hours make up RMV-approved Junior Operator driver education?
sec02-card-sec02-F15.teaching_text: Memorize all three hour totals because tests frequently swap behind-the-wheel hours with backseat observation hours.
sec02-card-sec02-F15.must_match_memory_hook: Thirty class, twelve drive, six observe

visual_sync.text_span: Thirty class, twelve drive, six observe

sec02-card-sec02-F16.question_text: How many additional supervised driving hours must a parent or guardian normally certify for a Junior Operator?
sec02-card-sec02-F16.teaching_text: Driving-school lessons alone are not enough without forty extra family-supervised practice hours signed off.

sec02-card-sec02-F17.question_text: How many parent-supervised hours does the RMV accept if you complete a driver skills development program?
sec02-card-sec02-F17.teaching_text: Finishing an approved advanced skills course trims ten hours off the standard forty-hour parent practice log.
sec02-card-sec02-F17.must_match_memory_hook: Skills program drops hours to thirty

visual_sync.text_span: Skills program drops hours to thirty

sec02-card-sec02-F18.question_text: How long is the required parent driver-education session, and when is a parent exempt from repeating it?
sec02-card-sec02-F18.teaching_text: Parents who sat through the two-hour briefing for an older sibling within five years skip repeating it.

sec02-card-sec02-F19.question_text: What step must you complete before your school sends the driver-education certificate electronically?
sec02-card-sec02-F19.teaching_text: Your driving school cannot upload completion to the RMV until you pass its final course exam.

sec02-card-sec02-F20.question_text: Who may ride with a Junior Operator during the first six months without a qualifying adult present?
sec02-card-sec02-F20.teaching_text: Teen friends multiply crash risk fast, so only immediate family under eighteen can ride solo with you.
sec02-card-sec02-F20.must_match_memory_hook: No non-family peers first six months

visual_sync.text_span: No non-family peers first six months

sec02-card-sec02-F21.question_text: What seat, age, experience, and license rules apply to an adult lifting the Junior passenger restriction?
sec02-card-sec02-F21.teaching_text: Putting a twenty-one-year-old in the back seat fails the exception because they must sit right beside you.

sec02-card-sec02-F22.question_text: What two milestones end the Junior Operator passenger restriction, and which one controls?
sec02-card-sec02-F22.teaching_text: Turning eighteen lifts the peer-passenger ban immediately even if your six-month window has time left.
sec02-card-sec02-F22.must_match_memory_hook: Six months or eighteen, whichever first

visual_sync.text_span: Six months or eighteen, whichever first

sec02-card-sec02-F23.question_text: How does a license suspension affect a Junior Operator's six-month passenger-restriction countdown?
sec02-card-sec02-F23.teaching_text: Notice the contrast with permits, since a Junior license suspension freezes your remaining passenger days until reinstatement.
sec02-card-sec02-F23.must_match_memory_hook: Suspension freezes passenger clock, finish later

visual_sync.text_span: Suspension freezes passenger clock, finish later

sec02-card-sec02-F24.question_text: Between what late-night hours does the Junior Operator nighttime driving restriction apply?
sec02-card-sec02-F24.teaching_text: Don't confuse permit midnight hours with the Junior license curfew starting at twelve-thirty in the morning.

sec02-card-sec02-F25.question_text: Who may accompany a Junior Operator to drive legally during restricted late-night hours?
sec02-card-sec02-F25.teaching_text: Unlike the passenger rule, any random twenty-one-year-old friend cannot cover late-night Junior driving.

sec02-card-sec02-F26.question_text: What criminal charge can result from violating the Junior Operator nighttime driving restriction?
sec02-card-sec02-F26.teaching_text: Driving solo past curfew invalidates your license authority for those hours, exposing you to criminal court.

sec02-card-sec02-F27.question_text: During which two thirty-minute or one-hour windows is the Junior night curfew enforced only after another stop?
sec02-card-sec02-F27.teaching_text: Police enforce curfew as a secondary violation in those buffer windows, leaving one-to-four primary.
sec02-card-sec02-F27.must_match_memory_hook: Twelve-thirty to one, four to five

visual_sync.text_span: Twelve-thirty to one, four to five

sec02-card-sec02-F28.question_text: Does secondary enforcement make solo Junior driving between twelve-thirty and one or four and five legal?
sec02-card-sec02-F28.teaching_text: One broken taillight or rolling stop during those windows still lands you a full curfew violation.

sec02-card-sec02-F29.question_text: What suspension lengths apply to first, second, and later Junior passenger or night restriction violations?
sec02-card-sec02-F29.teaching_text: Breaking passenger or curfew rules just once sidelines your license for two full months immediately.

sec02-card-sec02-F30.question_text: What course is required after a second or subsequent Junior passenger or nighttime violation?

sec02-card-sec02-F32.question_text: May a Junior Operator drive any vehicle that requires a commercial driver license?

sec02-card-sec02-F34.question_text: What extra suspension applies to drivers aged eighteen to twenty-one for specified alcohol or drug driving offenses?

sec02-card-sec02-R01.question_text: What additional suspensions hit a Junior Operator for a first and a repeat drag-racing offense?

sec02-card-sec02-R04.question_text: Do REAL ID and Standard Massachusetts applicants bring the exact same identification documents?

sec02-card-sec02-R06.question_text: How many documents proving Massachusetts residence must a REAL ID applicant bring?

sec02-card-sec02-R08.question_text: How many documents proving identity and date of birth does a Standard Massachusetts card applicant need?
sec02-card-sec02-R08.teaching_text: Some standalone primary documents cover both identity and birth date alone, while others must pair up.

sec02-card-sec02-R09.question_text: How many documents showing Massachusetts residence must a Standard card applicant provide?

sec02-card-sec02-R10.question_text: How can a Standard card applicant satisfy the Social Security requirement without bringing a paper card?

sec02-card-sec02-R11.question_text: Which four items let a Standard card applicant use a Social Security denial notice?

sec02-card-sec02-R12.question_text: For which card type may eligible applicants use the No Social Security Number Affidavit, and where is it barred?

sec02-card-sec02-R16.question_text: Which two altered or duplicated forms of identification documents will the RMV reject?

sec02-card-sec02-R19.question_text: What extra paperwork must an applicant submit when their visa requires an accompanying form?

sec02-card-sec02-R20.question_text: Why does the RMV direct applicants to check its current identification information before applying?

sec02-card-sec02-R28.question_text: Within how many days of receiving a written RMV denial may an applicant file an appeal?
sec02-card-sec02-R28.teaching_text: Ten calendar days pass quickly, so missing that tight filing window forfeits your appeal right.

sec02-card-sec02-R29.question_text: Does pursuing an informal RMV review extend the ten-day deadline to appeal a denial?
sec02-card-sec02-R29.teaching_text: Waiting around for an informal answer can burn your ten-day window and lock out formal appeal.

sec02-card-sec02-R30.question_text: Where does a formal application-denial appeal go, and what payment is required?
sec02-card-sec02-R30.teaching_text: Cash or personal cards will not work when filing, so send a fifty-dollar check or money order.

sec02-card-sec02-R31.question_text: What credential must every applicant obtain before applying for a Massachusetts driver license?
sec02-card-sec02-R31.teaching_text: Even adult newcomers without an out-of-state license start with a learner permit before road testing.

sec02-card-sec02-R32.question_text: What five items or exams are required to obtain a Massachusetts learner permit?
sec02-card-sec02-R32.teaching_text: Completing the form, proofs, payment, eye check, and knowledge exam unlocks supervised practice privileges.

sec02-card-sec02-R33.question_text: What two final steps turn a learner permit into a Massachusetts driver license?
sec02-card-sec02-R33.teaching_text: Passing the examiner's road evaluation still will not issue your license if unpaid fees remain open.

sec02-card-sec02-R34.question_text: What must an applicant do if their Massachusetts learner permit expires before licensing?
sec02-card-sec02-R34.teaching_text: Permits cannot simply be extended at the counter, so letting yours expire means retesting and repaying.

sec03-card-sec03-F01.question_text: Why does the RMV tell applicants to use its own website instead of look-alike third-party sites?
sec03-card-sec03-F01.teaching_text: Copycat sites often tack on junk charges or harvest your banking and identity details during booking.

sec03-card-sec03-F02.question_text: What is the minimum age to apply for a Massachusetts Class D learner permit?
sec03-card-sec03-F02.teaching_text: Wait until your sixteenth birthday arrives, because earlier applications get turned back at the counter.

sec03-card-sec03-F03.question_text: What two broad subject areas does the Massachusetts learner-permit exam measure?
sec03-card-sec03-F03.teaching_text: Studying only road signs leaves you short when legal rules and safe-driving habits show up together.

sec03-card-sec03-F04.question_text: What minimum age must the accompanying licensed operator be when you practice on a learner permit?
sec03-card-sec03-F04.teaching_text: Having an eighteen- or twenty-year-old licensed friend ride shotgun still violates Massachusetts permit supervision rules.

sec03-card-sec03-F05.question_text: Up to how many years can a Massachusetts learner permit remain valid?
sec03-card-sec03-F05.teaching_text: Letting that two-year clock run out before passing your road test forces a full permit retest.

sec03-card-sec03-F06.question_text: Which future licensing fees may an applicant prepay while applying for a learner permit?
sec03-card-sec03-F06.teaching_text: Knocking out both payments upfront saves you an extra payment step once road-test day arrives.

sec03-card-sec03-F07.question_text: What happens after you pass your road test if all required fees were already paid?
sec03-card-sec03-F07.teaching_text: Prepaying skips a second service-center line because the RMV mails your new license straight out.

sec03-card-sec03-F08.question_text: How do you submit a learner-permit application, and what step can be completed beforehand?
sec03-card-sec03-F08.teaching_text: Walk-ins waste time when a reserved appointment paired with online pre-entry speeds counter review.

sec03-card-sec03-F16.question_text: What kind of privilege does a learner permit grant, and for what purpose is it not intended?

sec03-card-sec03-F17.question_text: Which five specific topic areas are covered on the Massachusetts learner-permit exam?

sec03-card-sec03-F18.question_text: How do automated testing stations at full-service RMV centers present permit-exam questions?

sec03-card-sec03-F19.question_text: Are driver manuals or reference notes allowed during the permit exam or inside the testing area?

sec03-card-sec03-F20.question_text: May you wear or use an electronic device for any purpose during the learner-permit exam?
sec03-card-sec03-F20.teaching_text: Checking the time on a smartwatch or keeping earbuds in still triggers the strict electronics ban.

sec03-card-sec03-F21.question_text: Under what single condition may headphones or audio gear be worn during the permit exam?

sec03-card-sec03-F22.question_text: For what two reasons may an applicant keep a hat on during the learner-permit exam?
sec03-card-sec03-F22.teaching_text: Ballcaps and hoodies must come off before testing unless worn for medical or religious needs.

sec03-card-sec03-F23.question_text: How does the RMV classify using a manual, reference sheet, or electronic device during the permit exam?
sec03-card-sec03-F23.teaching_text: Glancing at a phone notification mid-exam gets treated the exact same way as crib notes.

sec03-card-sec03-F24.question_text: What two immediate consequences follow being caught cheating or attempting to cheat on the permit exam?
sec03-card-sec03-F24.teaching_text: Even an unsuccessful attempt ends your exam on the spot and opens an RMV investigation.

sec03-card-sec03-F25.question_text: How long is someone found responsible for permit-exam cheating barred from holding any license or permit?
sec03-card-sec03-F25.teaching_text: Getting found responsible locks you out of every Massachusetts permit and license class for two months.

sec03-card-sec03-R05.question_text: Do you need advance scheduling or disability paperwork to choose an audio permit exam?
sec03-card-sec03-R05.teaching_text: Auditory learners can pick spoken playback on exam day with zero pre-approval or extra forms.

sec03-card-sec03-R06.question_text: What gear should you bring if you want an audio exam at an RMV Service Center?
sec03-card-sec03-R06.teaching_text: Packing headphones that plug into the kiosk's universal splitter ensures smooth audio playback on site.

sec03-card-sec03-R07.question_text: What kind of disability can support requesting a reasonable testing accommodation from the RMV?
sec03-card-sec03-R07.teaching_text: When a cognitive or physical condition blocks standard kiosk testing, tailored exam support keeps access fair.

sec03-card-sec03-R08.question_text: What two examples of reasonable permit-exam accommodations are named in the manual?
sec03-card-sec03-R08.teaching_text: Extended clocks or one-on-one staff reading remove pacing and screen barriers without changing driving standards.

sec03-card-sec03-R09.question_text: What four pieces of information should an applicant include when requesting a testing accommodation?
sec03-card-sec03-R09.teaching_text: Giving your contact details, needed support, and preferred branch upfront prevents scheduling back-and-forth.

sec03-card-sec03-R10.question_text: What supporting paperwork may the RMV require before granting a testing accommodation?
sec03-card-sec03-R10.teaching_text: Tailored medical or educational records help staff match the requested testing setup to your condition.

sec03-card-sec03-R12.question_text: What three details do you give to request an American Sign Language interpreter, and what happens next?

sec03-card-sec03-R13.question_text: When must a learner carry their permit, and until what milestone?
sec03-card-sec03-R13.teaching_text: Leaving your permit at home during a quick practice spin counts as driving without proof.

sec03-card-sec03-R14.question_text: What seat, age, license, and experience rules apply to the adult supervising a Class D permit driver?

sec03-card-sec03-R15.question_text: Who must accompany a permit driver under eighteen between midnight and five in the morning?

sec03-card-sec03-R16.question_text: When may a Massachusetts Class D learner permit be used to drive in another state?
sec03-card-sec03-R16.teaching_text: Neighboring states set different minimum learner ages and permit rules, so check local laws before crossing.

sec03-card-sec03-R17.question_text: Where must drivers younger than eighteen take professional driving lessons?
sec03-card-sec03-R17.teaching_text: Family coaching alone cannot substitute for professional instruction when licensing before your eighteenth birthday.

sec03-card-sec03-R18.question_text: Who licenses and monitors every Massachusetts professional driving school, including high-school programs?
sec03-card-sec03-R18.teaching_text: Both private academies and high-school driver-ed courses stay under RMV oversight so training meets state standards.

sec03-card-sec03-R19.question_text: What can an applicant ask to inspect if unsure about a driving school's legitimacy?
sec03-card-sec03-R19.teaching_text: Verifying the school's certificate upfront ensures your tuition and hours will count toward licensing.

sec03-card-sec03-R20.question_text: What education, exam, and filing steps must applicants aged sixteen and a half to eighteen complete?

sec03-card-sec03-R21.question_text: How many supervised practice hours are required normally versus after a driver skills development program?

sec03-card-sec03-R22.question_text: How much driver-education curriculum must a parent or guardian attend, and what is the five-year rule?

sec03-card-sec03-R24.question_text: What is the maximum number of Class D road tests an applicant may attempt in twelve months?

sec03-card-sec03-R25.question_text: How much notice avoids an extra fee when canceling or rescheduling a road test?

sec03-card-sec03-R26.question_text: When is a driving instructor allowed to sponsor an applicant's road test?

sec03-card-sec03-R27.question_text: How many days must pass after a failed or missed road test before taking another one?

sec03-card-sec03-R28.question_text: What two consequences hit an applicant who arrives late for a scheduled road test?

sec03-card-sec03-R29.question_text: What financial requirement must be met before scheduling a new road test?
sec03-card-sec03-R29.teaching_text: Unpaid late-test or missed-appointment balances block the booking system from giving you a new date.

sec04-card-sec04-F01.question_text: What happens to scheduled Massachusetts road tests during a governor-declared state of emergency — statewide versus regional?
sec04-card-sec04-F01.teaching_text: Don't drive out in a storm emergency — a statewide declaration cancels everywhere while a regional order cancels that zone.

sec04-card-sec04-F02.question_text: If an examiner cancels your road test due to unsafe weather, what happens to your fee when rescheduling?
sec04-card-sec04-F02.teaching_text: Weather cancellations called by the RMV never penalize your wallet when you rebook a safer day.

sec04-card-sec04-F03.question_text: Besides failing on the road, which five arrival, vehicle, or sponsor missteps still trigger the road-test fee?
sec04-card-sec04-F03.teaching_text: Showing up late, missing your slot, or bringing an unqualified car or sponsor burns your thirty-five-dollar fee.

sec04-card-sec04-F04.question_text: Canceling or rescheduling a Massachusetts road test with less than how many hours of notice triggers the fee?
sec04-card-sec04-F04.teaching_text: Give at least three full days of notice so another applicant can claim your examiner slot without costing you.

sec04-card-sec04-F05.question_text: What may an examiner do if either the road-test applicant OR the sponsor appears impaired by alcohol or another substance?
sec04-card-sec04-F05.teaching_text: Even a sober teen gets turned away at the curb if their supervising sponsor shows impairment signs.

sec04-card-sec04-F06.question_text: Which two odors — coming from which four sources — let an examiner reject a road test on the spot?
sec04-card-sec04-F06.teaching_text: Hotboxed upholstery or lingering smells on clothing, applicant, or sponsor end your appointment before the key turns.

sec04-card-sec04-F07.question_text: Why can bringing unsupervised children or pets cancel your road test — and how do service versus emotional-support animals differ?
sec04-card-sec04-F07.teaching_text: RMV staff cannot babysit kids or pets in the lot, and emotional-support animals do not qualify.

sec04-card-sec04-F38.question_text: Roughly how many minutes before your scheduled road-test slot should you arrive?
sec04-card-sec04-F38.teaching_text: Checking paperwork and staging your car fifteen minutes ahead prevents a chargeable late mark.

sec04-card-sec04-F39.question_text: Must you turn off backup cameras or parking assist for a road test, and how does the examiner judge you?
sec04-card-sec04-F39.teaching_text: Staring solely at a center screen without turning your head fails the core skill check.

sec04-card-sec04-F40.question_text: What gets added to your license if you require adaptive equipment or specialized vehicle features to drive?
sec04-card-sec04-F40.teaching_text: Matching license restrictions to required hand controls or driving aids keeps every future vehicle you drive safe.

sec04-card-sec04-F41.question_text: Which three people normally ride inside the vehicle during a road test, and what fourth person may join when permitted?
sec04-card-sec04-F41.teaching_text: Friends and siblings wait outside so only official test participants occupy the cabin.

sec04-card-sec04-R01.question_text: Draw the exact line on road-test cabin occupants between trained service animals, pets, emotional-support animals, and children?
sec04-card-sec04-R01.teaching_text: Only a trained service animal rides along — kids, family pets, and emotional-support animals stay out.

sec04-card-sec04-R02.question_text: When may an applicant speak with their sponsor or interpreter once the road test is underway?
sec04-card-sec04-R02.teaching_text: Unauthorized back-seat coaching or side chatter looks like cheating and disrupts examiner directions.

sec04-card-sec04-R03.question_text: How can a deaf or hard-of-hearing applicant arrange an interpreter for their Massachusetts road test?
sec04-card-sec04-R03.teaching_text: Booking through official RMV accommodations lines up an approved interpreter before test day.

sec04-card-sec04-R04.question_text: What two preparation steps happen before a deaf or hard-of-hearing applicant's road test starts?
sec04-card-sec04-R04.teaching_text: Agreeing on hand cues and reading written maneuvers with the interpreter prevents mid-drive confusion.

sec04-card-sec04-R05.question_text: If you need to clarify something with the examiner during a road test, how should you handle it?
sec04-card-sec04-R05.teaching_text: Keeping eyes forward until safely parked shows mature vehicle control while getting your answer.

sec04-card-sec04-R06.question_text: What policy does the Massachusetts RMV enforce toward violent or abusive behavior by applicants or sponsors?
sec04-card-sec04-R06.teaching_text: Losing your temper — or bringing an aggressive sponsor — immediately ends testing under strict RMV rules.

sec04-card-sec04-F08.question_text: What extra signature must appear on a Class D road-test application when the applicant is under eighteen?
sec04-card-sec04-F08.teaching_text: Forgetting parental sign-off on a junior application stalls your appointment at check-in.

sec04-card-sec04-F09.question_text: What must you disclose on the road-test application regarding health or prescriptions — and what clearance is needed beforehand?
sec04-card-sec04-F09.teaching_text: Arriving with signed doctor clearance already in hand keeps disclosed conditions from delaying your test.

sec04-card-sec04-F10.question_text: When a road-test application discloses a medical condition, which two paths can the examiner take?
sec04-card-sec04-F10.teaching_text: Complex disclosures go to RMV Medical Affairs for specialist review before road testing proceeds.

sec04-card-sec04-F11.question_text: In what physical form must a Class D road-test applicant bring their learner permit?
sec04-card-sec04-F11.teaching_text: Phone screenshots fail check-in because examiners stamp the paper permit as a temporary license upon passing.

sec04-card-sec04-F12.question_text: What document must your road-test sponsor physically carry to the appointment?
sec04-card-sec04-F12.teaching_text: An expired or forgotten sponsor wallet card cancels the road test and triggers a fee.

sec04-card-sec04-F13.question_text: What vehicle standards and document must the applicant bring for the test car?
sec04-card-sec04-F13.teaching_text: Examiners verify the physical registration certificate before stepping inside any test car.

sec04-card-sec04-F14.question_text: How many consecutive months of clean driving must an applicant under eighteen hold right before applying for a road test?
sec04-card-sec04-F14.teaching_text: Junior Operator Law rewards half a year of incident-free permit practice before solo licensing.

sec04-card-sec04-F15.question_text: Which three categories of incidents, suspensions, or convictions reset a junior applicant's six-month clean-driving clock?
sec04-card-sec04-F15.teaching_text: Even a non-driving alcohol or drug conviction interrupts a teen's road-test eligibility window.

sec04-card-sec04-F16.question_text: If a disqualifying event hits a junior applicant AFTER booking a road test, what happens — and what age exception applies?
sec04-card-sec04-F16.teaching_text: Your record must stay clean right through test day unless turning eighteen lifts the junior rule first.

sec04-card-sec04-F17.question_text: Does holding a valid foreign driver license exempt a Class D road-test applicant from bringing a sponsor?
sec04-card-sec04-F17.teaching_text: Foreign-licensed drivers often assume they can drive solo to the test and forfeit their appointment.

sec04-card-sec04-F18.question_text: What minimum age, driving experience, and license origin qualify someone to be a Class D road-test sponsor?
sec04-card-sec04-F18.teaching_text: Check all three boxes beforehand — twenty years old or under a year licensed gets rejected.

sec04-card-sec04-F19.question_text: May someone whose driver license was issued by a foreign country act as your road-test sponsor?
sec04-card-sec04-F19.teaching_text: Sponsors must hold a valid US home-state license rather than an international or foreign credential.

sec04-card-sec04-F20.question_text: Without special RMV Road Test Program approval, how many different applicants may one driver sponsor in a year?
sec04-card-sec04-F20.teaching_text: Capping unapproved sponsors at three applicants yearly blocks unlicensed driving schools from operating.

sec04-card-sec04-F21.question_text: What happens if an examiner deems your test vehicle unsafe, and what two compliance items are required?
sec04-card-sec04-F21.teaching_text: Bald tires, cracked glass, or an expired inspection sticker ends the exam at pre-check.

sec04-card-sec04-F22.question_text: Where inside the test vehicle must seats exist for the examiner and for the sponsor?
sec04-card-sec04-F22.teaching_text: Two-seat sports coupes fail check-in because the sponsor needs a rear seat behind the driver.

sec04-card-sec04-F23.question_text: Can your sponsor ride in the cargo bed of a two-passenger pickup truck during a road test?
sec04-card-sec04-F23.teaching_text: Sponsors must sit belted inside a real rear cabin seat, never an open truck bed.

sec04-card-sec04-F24.question_text: Whether manual lever or electric button, what access requirement applies to the test car's parking brake?
sec04-card-sec04-F24.teaching_text: Without a dual foot pedal, a reachable center parking brake is the examiner's sole emergency stop.

sec04-card-sec04-F25.question_text: Who makes the final call on parking-brake accessibility — and what cabin placement avoids trouble?
sec04-card-sec04-F25.teaching_text: Left-kickpanel pedals or dash buttons hidden left of the steering column won't pass examiner reach.

sec04-card-sec04-F26.question_text: Is the road-test fee charged if your scheduled test cannot run SOLELY because the examiner cannot reach the braking system?
sec04-card-sec04-F26.teaching_text: Watch this key exception — unlike other bad-vehicle rejections, brake-reach layout alone waives the fee.

sec04-card-sec04-F27.question_text: What two special items must a driving-instruction vehicle carry?
sec04-card-sec04-F27.teaching_text: Passenger-side brake pedals give driving instructors and examiners instant emergency stopping control.

sec04-card-sec04-F28.question_text: What happens if your vehicle's parking brake fails the legally required pre-drive holding check?
sec04-card-sec04-F28.teaching_text: Even a center-console lever gets rejected if worn cables let the car roll.

sec04-card-sec04-F29.question_text: Why can a working parking brake still get a road-test car rejected?
sec04-card-sec04-F29.teaching_text: An examiner seated on the right cannot dive across the driver's knees during a sudden hazard.

sec04-card-sec04-F30.question_text: What three dollar coverage minimums must an out-of-state test vehicle prove to meet Massachusetts standards?
sec04-card-sec04-F30.teaching_text: Out-of-state policies with lower home minimums get turned away without twenty-five/fifty/thirty coverage proof.

sec04-card-sec04-F31.question_text: Which two documents stating coverage limits can prove insurance for a road-test vehicle?
sec04-card-sec04-F31.teaching_text: A bare ID card that omits dollar coverage amounts won't prove twenty-five/fifty/thirty compliance.

sec04-card-sec04-F32.question_text: What two documents — and what dual permission — are required to take a road test in a rented vehicle?
sec04-card-sec04-F32.teaching_text: Standard rental contracts ban learner drivers unless company letterhead explicitly names applicant and sponsor.

sec04-card-sec04-F33.question_text: Do you need rental-company authorization letters when bringing a leased vehicle to a road test?
sec04-card-sec04-F33.teaching_text: Long-term leases register like personal vehicles, sparing you from bringing rental-counter letterhead paperwork.

sec04-card-sec04-F34.question_text: May you take a Massachusetts road test on a limited-use donut spare tire?
sec04-card-sec04-F34.teaching_text: Temporary compact spares compromise braking grip and handling stability during road-test maneuvers.

sec04-card-sec04-F35.question_text: Which three roles are the ONLY applicants allowed to use a dealer-plated passenger car for a road test?
sec04-card-sec04-F35.teaching_text: Borrowing a family friend's dealer-tag car fails check-in unless you hold one of those three roles.

sec04-card-sec04-F36.question_text: What relationship proof AND vehicle-type requirement apply to a farm-plated road-test vehicle?
sec04-card-sec04-F36.teaching_text: Farm plates belong on working trucks like crew-cab pickups with a sponsor seat, never sedans.

sec04-card-sec04-F37.question_text: Under what circumstances may a vehicle displaying a repair plate be used for a road test?
sec04-card-sec04-F37.teaching_text: Unlike narrow dealer or farm exceptions, repair tags have zero road-test exceptions.

sec04-card-sec04-R07.question_text: Which three conditions let the examiner validate your paper permit as a temporary license right after passing?
sec04-card-sec04-R07.teaching_text: Prepaying your license fee online beforehand lets you drive away licensed once the examiner signs.

sec04-card-sec04-R08.question_text: How long does a validated learner permit serve as a temporary license — and what cuts it shorter?
sec04-card-sec04-R08.teaching_text: Check your underlying permit expiration date so your temporary driving privilege doesn't lapse early.

sec04-card-sec04-R09.question_text: When must an applicant older than twenty book a service-center visit to get their license?
sec04-card-sec04-R09.teaching_text: Switching from a vertical under-twenty-one photo taken in your teens requires a fresh adult portrait.

sec04-card-sec04-R10.question_text: If you pass without prepaying, how many days do you have to pay or visit — and what penalty risks hitting afterward?
sec04-card-sec04-R10.teaching_text: Letting two months slip by unpaid can force you to pay for and pass a brand-new road test.

sec04-card-sec04-R11.question_text: If you pass unpaid and later pay online WITHOUT visiting a service center, do you get a temporary license?
sec04-card-sec04-R11.teaching_text: Without an examiner stamp or service-center receipt in hand, wait for the plastic card before driving solo.

sec04-card-sec04-R12.question_text: Which two locations satisfy Massachusetts law for carrying your valid driver license while driving?
sec04-card-sec04-R12.teaching_text: Locking your wallet inside the trunk fails the easy-reach rule during a traffic stop.

sec04-card-sec04-R13.question_text: What does an RMV service-center temporary receipt prove — and where does it NOT count as valid ID?
sec04-card-sec04-R13.teaching_text: Paper receipts satisfy traffic stops while your card prints, never airport TSA security checkpoints.

sec04-card-sec04-R14.question_text: Whose information is forwarded to election officials during an RMV permit, license, or ID transaction?
sec04-card-sec04-R14.teaching_text: Automatic voter registration keeps eligible citizen rolls updated right through routine RMV visits.

sec04-card-sec04-R15.question_text: What two choices do local election officials mail you after receiving your RMV voter data?
sec04-card-sec04-R15.teaching_text: Automatic transfer never locks you in — the follow-up mailer lets you enroll in a party or opt out.

sec04-card-sec04-R16.question_text: What citizenship status and minimum age allow you to register to vote in Massachusetts?
sec04-card-sec04-R16.teaching_text: Sixteen-year-old learner-permit applicants who hold US citizenship can pre-register early at the counter.

sec04-card-sec04-R17.question_text: Even though registration opens at sixteen, what minimum age is required to actually cast a vote?
sec04-card-sec04-R17.teaching_text: Don't mix the two numbers — register at sixteen, cast ballots starting at eighteen.

sec04-card-sec04-R18.question_text: How does a registered voter's address change travel to their town, and what confirms the update?
sec04-card-sec04-R18.teaching_text: Updating your RMV address routes through the central voter registry so your local clerk mails confirmation.

sec04-card-sec04-R19.question_text: Which service members qualify to add the Veteran indicator to a Massachusetts license or ID?
sec04-card-sec04-R19.teaching_text: Honorable discharge status from the Armed Forces unlocks the printed Veteran designation on state credentials.

sec04-card-sec04-R20.question_text: How much extra does adding the Veteran indicator cost — even if your current card isn't up for renewal yet?
sec04-card-sec04-R20.teaching_text: Eligible veterans never have to pay a twenty-five-dollar duplicate fee just to add the indicator mid-cycle.

sec04-card-sec04-R21.question_text: Which three discharge forms prove eligibility for the Veteran indicator — and how must the text appear?
sec04-card-sec04-R21.teaching_text: Handwritten discharge entries get rejected at the counter; bring typed official forms.

sec04-card-sec04-R22.question_text: What voluntary donation choice may any Massachusetts license or ID applicant make?
sec04-card-sec04-R22.teaching_text: Checking yes during licensing gives every applicant a simple path to help transplant patients.

sec04-card-sec04-R23.question_text: What two things happen legally when you register as a donor through the RMV?
sec04-card-sec04-R23.teaching_text: RMV enrollment serves as binding first-person legal consent inside the Massachusetts Donor Registry.

sec04-card-sec04-R24.question_text: Where and when can someone join or change their Massachusetts organ-donor status?
sec04-card-sec04-R24.teaching_text: You never have to wait five years for license renewal to join or opt out online.

sec04-card-sec04-R25.question_text: If you are ALREADY in the Donor Registry, what must you still mark on your renewal form to stay enrolled?
sec04-card-sec04-R25.teaching_text: Skipping or checking no on a renewal form drops an existing donor off the registry.

sec04-card-sec04-R26.question_text: What optional dollar contribution can you add during an online renewal or duplicate order?
sec04-card-sec04-R26.teaching_text: Adding two voluntary dollars during online orders supports statewide organ-and-tissue donor education and registration.

sec04-card-sec04-R27.question_text: What symbol printed on a Massachusetts license or ID shows Donor Registry membership and consent?
sec04-card-sec04-R27.teaching_text: Emergency and hospital teams recognize the heart icon immediately as legal donation consent.

sec04-card-sec04-R28.question_text: Can someone belong to the Massachusetts Donor Registry before a heart appears on their physical card?
sec04-card-sec04-R28.teaching_text: Joining the registry online takes effect immediately without paying for a replacement plastic card.

sec04-card-sec04-R29.question_text: What does the Massachusetts Donor Registry store, and how is it checked?
sec04-card-sec04-R29.teaching_text: Electronic lookup confirms online enrollees even when their older wallet card lacks a heart.

sec04-card-sec04-R30.question_text: Does a driver whose license already displays the donor heart need to carry a separate donor card?
sec04-card-sec04-R30.teaching_text: Your state license heart icon and electronic registry entry already complete legal authorization.

sec04-card-sec04-R31.question_text: How much is a donor's family charged for organ or tissue donation?
sec04-card-sec04-R31.teaching_text: Clearing up this myth matters — families never receive medical bills for organ or tissue recovery.

sec04-card-sec04-R32.question_text: How much is the Massachusetts learner-permit exam fee, and what two items does it cover?
sec04-card-sec04-R32.teaching_text: Keep Massachusetts fees straight — thirty for the permit exam, thirty-five road test, fifty Class D license.

sec04-card-sec04-R33.question_text: Which two events require paying a brand-new learner-permit exam fee to test again?
sec04-card-sec04-R33.teaching_text: Each knowledge retake or expired two-year permit triggers another thirty-dollar exam fee.

sec04-card-sec04-R34.question_text: What is the dollar fee for a Massachusetts road test?
sec04-card-sec04-R34.teaching_text: Spot the five-dollar step up — thirty for the written permit test, thirty-five for the road test.

sec04-card-sec04-R35.question_text: Which four unsuccessful road-test outcomes still owe the thirty-five-dollar fee before you can book again?
sec04-card-sec04-R35.teaching_text: Any unpaid thirty-five-dollar road-test balance blocks your account from booking a new appointment.

sec04-card-sec04-R36.question_text: How much does issuing or renewing a standard five-year Massachusetts Class D license cost?
sec04-card-sec04-R36.teaching_text: Fifty dollars covers either your first five-year Class D card or a standard five-year renewal.

sec04-card-sec04-R37.question_text: How is the fee calculated when a license is issued for less than five years?
sec04-card-sec04-R37.teaching_text: Limited-term credentials only charge for the fraction of the five-year span issued.

sec04-card-sec04-R38.question_text: How much does ordering a duplicate or amended Massachusetts license cost?
sec04-card-sec04-R38.teaching_text: Replacing a lost card costs half the fifty-dollar full Class D issuance fee.

sec04-card-sec04-R39.question_text: Are Massachusetts license fees refundable, and are printed manual amounts locked permanently?
sec04-card-sec04-R39.teaching_text: Always double-check your application details before paying because Massachusetts RMV fees are non-refundable.

sec04-card-sec04-R40.question_text: Which veterans pay zero Massachusetts driver-license transaction fees?
sec04-card-sec04-R40.teaching_text: Holding Disabled Veteran plates or Medical Affairs qualification waives driver-license transaction fees.

sec05-card-sec05-F01.question_text: Beyond protecting the driver, which two groups benefit directly from safe driving habits?
